title.zh: v2.0.41 虚拟键盘 100% 水平全宽响应、卷帘全屏防遮挡与全域置顶、悬浮按键与移动端精简控制条
title.en: v2.0.41 Virtual Keyboard 100% Responsive Width, Fullscreen Non-Obscured Z-Index, FAB Toggle & Mobile Quick Control Bar

highlights.zh: **虚拟键盘 100% 水平全宽响应式自适应（100% Responsive Width Keybed）**：彻底消除虚拟键盘两侧留白与宽度受限问题。容器设置 100% 全宽并针对桌面端设置 1200px 黄金居中最大宽度，白键采用 flex: 1 0 auto 均分宽度并设立最小触控安全边界；黑键根据白键边界精准计算居中位置与 60% 相对黄金键宽，完美适配从超宽带鱼屏到掌上触屏设备的各种视口。
highlights.en: **100% Responsive Width Keybed**: Eliminated fixed modal width clamping and horizontal margin gaps. The virtual keyboard container now fills 100% width up to 1200px desktop max-width, with white keys equally dividing space via flex: 1 0 auto and black keys positioned dynamically on white key boundaries with 60% relative width.

highlights.zh: **钢琴卷帘全屏防遮挡与全域最高置顶（Fullscreen Non-Obscured & Fixed Top Layer）**：将虚拟键盘（Musical Typing）提升为全站绝对最高层级（z-index: 9999），固定吸附于屏幕最底端。当钢琴卷帘进入全屏模式（z-[60]）时，虚拟键盘依然清晰可见、随时弹奏，彻底消除了全屏模式下键盘被遮挡无法演奏的体验断层。
highlights.en: **Fullscreen Non-Obscured & Fixed Top Layer**: Elevated the virtual keyboard modal to the absolute top layer (z-index: 9999) fixed to the bottom edge. When the piano roll expands to fullscreen (z-[60]), the keyboard remains prominently visible and playable without being covered.

highlights.zh: **虚拟键盘右下角悬浮键（FAB）与全局设置开关**：在工作台右下方增设专属圆形琴键悬浮键（FAB，带微光阴影与悬停放大动效），轻点即可随时展开虚拟键盘；键盘展开时自动让位。在「全局设置 → 界面设置」中新增「显示虚拟键盘悬浮键」持久化开关，随心定制操作习惯。
highlights.en: **Virtual Keyboard Floating Action Button (FAB) & Settings Switch**: Added a dedicated circular keyboard FAB on the bottom-right for instant 1-click keyboard launching. Includes a persistent toggle in "Global Settings -> Interface Defaults" to customize workspace density.

highlights.zh: **移动端底部精简高频控制条（Mobile Bottom Quick Control Bar）**：在窄屏移动设备底端固定轻量快捷控制条，直出播放/停止大按键、BPM -/+ 步进调节与琴键快速唤起开关三大高频操作，无需打开汉堡菜单即可单手单指极速掌控走带与演奏。
highlights.en: **Mobile Bottom Quick Control Bar**: Introduced a pinned bottom strip on mobile devices offering 1-thumb access to Play/Stop, BPM nudging, and keyboard launching without navigating through the mobile drawer menu.

title.zh: v2.0.40 交互式实操教学模式、工作站区域与功能按钮全景手册、新用户全景引导漫游
title.en: v2.0.40 Interactive Hands-on Tutorial Coach, Workstation Layout & Controls Manual, and New User Onboarding Tour

highlights.zh: **交互式实操教学模式（Interactive Tutorial Coach）**：彻底解决点击教程仅跳转页面而无教学状态的痛点。点击任一教程「进入实操教学」后自动进入教学模式，底端升起半透明磨砂悬浮实操指导小窗（Coach Dock），展示当前步骤实操指引、核心要领与 💡 实践技巧，集成「声学试听（即时触发纯 Web Audio 声音范例）」、「上一步/下一步（自动无缝切换工作台/调音台/分析仪视图）」及「折叠为迷你小窗」功能，伴随创作者沉浸式动手实操。
highlights.en: **Interactive Tutorial Coach**: Resolved the lack of active teaching state when launching tutorials. Clicking "Start Hands-on Tutorial" now launches an interactive guided session with a floating docked coach HUD, presenting step-by-step instructions, practical tips, instant synthesized audio auditions, seamless cross-tab view navigation, and a collapsible mini pill view.

highlights.zh: **工作站区域划分与功能按钮全景手册（Workstation UI & Controls Manual）**：帮助中心重磅上线专属「界面与功能全景手册」专栏，全面系统拆解 6 大工作站核心区域与每一个功能按钮、滑块、电平表及控制旋钮：顶部导航与走带控制栏（Space播放、BPM 40-240、Swing%、调式根音、Cmd+K 搜索）、8 轨点音矩阵与控制列（静音/独奏、力度通道、欧几里得律动、多节拍循环）、专业黑白键钢琴卷帘（3D 琴键、滑音试听、22 种音阶高亮、和弦印章虚影、连续琶音）、独立硬件调音台（推子、全景声像、延迟混响发送、砖墙限制器）、全景声谱分析仪与底鼓实验室（32 段 FFT、李萨如椭圆、纯音校准、底鼓瞬态扫频），以及和弦工坊与 3D 曲风星系。
highlights.en: **Workstation UI & Controls Manual**: Added a dedicated "UI & Interface Manual" section to the User Manual, providing component-by-component documentation across 6 core zones: Master Header & Transport Bar, Sequencer Grid & Track Controls, Studio Piano Roll & Virtual Keybed, Hardware Console Mixer Desk, Panoramic Analyzer & Kick Anatomy, and Chord Workshop & 3D Genre Galaxy.

highlights.zh: **新用户交互式全景引导漫游（New User Onboarding Tour）**：专为新进创作者设计 7 站沉浸式全景漫游（欢迎与纯物理合成、走带与全局主控、8 轨鼓机与步进网格、专业钢琴卷帘与和弦印章、独立调音台与声学实验室、和弦工坊与 3D 曲风星系、实操起步与快捷键全景）。首次访问自动推荐，随时可在顶部 Header 导航栏或帮助中心「开启全景引导漫游」重新开启，并提供一键直达「鼓机编排实操教学（第 1 课）」与直接进入编曲工作台两大行动入口。
highlights.en: **New User Onboarding Tour**: Designed a 7-milestone interactive walkthrough covering zero-sample pure synthesis, transport controls, drum sequencer matrix, studio piano roll, hardware console, chord theory, and keyboard shortcuts. Automatically offered to first-time visitors and accessible anytime from the header button or quickstart guide, with direct launchers to Lesson 1 hands-on practice or the studio workbench.

title.zh: v2.0.39 底鼓解剖实验室直达指南与工作台回归、声学课程双向跳转、和弦工坊直达钢琴卷帘实时编辑
title.en: v2.0.39 Kick Anatomy Lab Contextual Guide & Studio Return, Dual Acoustic Lesson Routing, and Chord Workshop Piano Roll Bridge

highlights.zh: **底鼓声学实验室专属手册与回归闭环（Kick Anatomy Lab Studio & Manual Integration）**：在底鼓设计/躯体声学实验室（KickAnatomyView）顶部遥测状态栏增设专属磨砂金光指南按钮（底鼓手册，直达混音与声学实验室手册）与高对比度「返回编曲台」快捷入口；全面打通从底鼓瞬态物理建模、低频下潜调试到主工作台的编曲创作流转闭环。
highlights.en: **Kick Anatomy Lab Studio & Manual Integration**: Equipped the Kick Design & Somatic Acoustics Lab with a dedicated frosted gold "Kick Lab Guide" button linking straight to acoustics/mixing documentation, alongside a high-visibility "Return to Studio" action. Creators can effortlessly inspect physical kick synthesis models and seamlessly jump back to the sequencer.

highlights.zh: **交互教学课程声学双向实操跳转（Dual Acoustic Lesson Routing）**：在交互式教学中心第 4 课「底鼓谐振解剖与全景声谱示波器」卡片中引入双向实操跳转架构。提供次要动作「进入底鼓实验室」与主要动作「查看全景声谱分析仪」，学习者可根据学习进度一键直达三段式物理谐振建模或 32 频段 FFT / 李萨如相位视区，彻底消除功能探索的认知割裂。
highlights.en: **Dual Acoustic Lesson Routing**: Upgraded Lesson 4 ("Kick Anatomy & Panoramic Acoustic Scope") in the Interactive Learning Center with dual action routing. Provides direct buttons to both the Kick Anatomy Lab and the Panoramic Analyzer Suite, letting learners jump straight into physical transient modeling or 32-band FFT/Lissajous visualizers directly from the course milestone.

highlights.zh: **和弦工坊直通专业钢琴卷帘编辑（Chord Workshop to Piano Roll Direct Bridge）**：在和弦走向与律动工坊（ChordProgressionsView）顶部工具栏增设专属「在卷帘中编辑」动作。创作者在探索经典或自定义和弦走向后，可一键将和弦载入和弦轨道并自动在工作台唤起专业钢琴卷帘，即刻进行音阶对齐、转位微调、Drop-2 爵士重排或力度动态塑形。
highlights.en: **Chord Workshop to Piano Roll Direct Bridge**: Introduced an "Edit in Piano Roll" action in the Chord Progressions Studio toolbar. Clicking immediately loads the authored chord progression into the sequencer chords track and automatically opens the Piano Roll editor on that track for instant visual editing, inversion adjustments, Drop-2 jazz re-voicing, and velocity humanization.

title.zh: v2.0.38 8大多维交互教学课程全量上线与全站视图专属手册直达闭环
title.en: v2.0.38 8-Track Interactive Course Curriculum & App-Wide Contextual Manual Deep-Linking

highlights.zh: **8 大交互式实操教学课程体系（8 Interactive Learning Courses）**：将教学中心实操教程由 5 门全量扩充至 8 门，完整覆盖系统全部技术与音乐学维度。新增第 6 课「和弦走向编配与调式和声理论」（和弦级数、4 种声学演奏风格与走向烘焙）、第 7 课「节奏大师课与交互式复节奏挑战」（复节奏对撞、Clave 进化树、Dilla 醉步微时序与敲击测试）、第 8 课「全球曲风星系与音乐史时间线探索」（3D 引力星系、引力连线脉络与年代轴演化）；全部配备分步实操指引与「立即前往体验」一键联动跳转。
highlights.en: **8 Interactive Learning Courses**: Expanded the interactive tutorial hub from 5 to 8 comprehensive guided tracks covering all DAW and musicological capabilities. Added Lesson 6 (Harmonic Progressions & Voicing Theory), Lesson 7 (Rhythm Masterclass & Polyrhythmic Challenges), and Lesson 8 (Musicology Galaxy & Evolutionary Timelines), complete with multi-step tips and 1-click launch routing.

highlights.zh: **全站各视图专属指南与手册深层联动（App-wide Contextual Manual Deep-Linking）**：在硬件调音台（ConsolePanel）、全景声谱分析仪（AnalyzerView）、和弦工坊（ChordProgressionsView）、曲风制作工坊（CustomGenreMakerView）及节奏大师课（MasterclassView）5 大核心视图顶部增设专属磨砂玻璃质感指南按钮（混音手册、声学手册、和声手册、工坊指南、大师课指南），轻点直达对应手册章节与实操课程，彻底打通功能实操与乐理教学闭环。
highlights.en: **App-Wide Contextual Manual Deep-Linking**: Integrated dedicated frosted glass guide buttons into Hardware Console, Panoramic Analyzer, Chord Progressions Studio, Custom Genre Maker, and Rhythm Masterclass headers. Each button deep-links directly into its specific manual chapter and interactive course without interrupting user workflows.

highlights.zh: **教学状态与检索动态计数同步优化**：快速上手与实操课程表头动态同步课程数量统计（8 门实操课程），关键词秒级检索无缝命中全部 8 门课程与 32 个分步教学节点，中英双语 100% 校验覆盖。
highlights.en: **Dynamic Learning Counters & Full Search Coverage**: Synchronized interactive course counters across Quick Start and tutorial headers, ensuring instant real-time search filtering across all 8 courses and 32 guided milestones with 100% bilingual parity.

title.zh: v2.0.37 钢琴卷帘经典和弦走向大师套件、力度泳道动态工具栏与手册直达联动
title.en: v2.0.37 Piano Roll Diatonic Chord Progression Suite, Velocity Lane Dynamics Toolbar & Manual Deep-Linking

highlights.zh: **经典和弦走向套件（Diatonic Chord Progression Suite）**：在钢琴卷帘 Deck 2 新增和弦走向编配套件。内置 Pop 4-Chords (I-V-vi-IV)、Emotional Lift (vi-IV-I-V)、Jazz 2-5-1 (ii-V-I-vi)、王道进行 J-Pop (IV-V-iii-vi)、Epic Minor (i-VI-III-VII)、Blues & Rock (I-IV-I-V)、Dorian Funk (i-IV) 及卡农走向 (Canon in D) 等 8 大经典和弦走向；结合当前选定调式音阶实时推导自然音阶级数和弦，支持一键实时多音试听与一键盖印平铺至全小节，创作和声骨架如虎添翼。
highlights.en: **Diatonic Chord Progression Suite**: Introduced a comprehensive progression authoring engine in Deck 2. Features 8 classic chord progressions (Pop 4-Chords, Emotional Lift, Jazz 2-5-1, Royal Road/J-Pop, Epic Minor, Blues & Rock, Dorian Funk, Canon in D) derived dynamically from the active scale and root key. Includes instant polyphonic chord auditioning and 1-click timeline stamping across bars with animated HUD confirmation.

highlights.zh: **力度泳道独立工具栏与声学动态塑形（Velocity Lane Dynamics Toolbar）**：在力度泳道表头增设专属磨砂玻璃硬件工具栏，提供人性化微动态（Humanize ±10 模拟真实演奏手感）、动态压缩（Compress 0.5 压缩比收拢极端力度）、线性渐强渐弱（Ramp ↗ / Ramp ↘）及基准力度（Level 100）等 5 大批处理工具；未选中音符时智能作用于全轨音符，大幅提升音符动态塑形效率。
highlights.en: **Velocity Lane Dynamics Toolbar**: Integrated a dedicated frosted hardware toolbar directly atop the velocity lane. Equips 5 dynamic shaping tools: Humanize (deterministic ±10 micro-dynamics jitter), Compress (0.5 ratio dynamic leveling toward 85 velocity), Ramp Up/Down (linear chronological crescendos and decrescendos), and Level 100. Gracefully applies to note selections or the entire track.

highlights.zh: **钢琴卷帘直达用户手册深层联动（Contextual Help Deep-Link）**：在 Deck 1 控制台右侧新增专属「卷帘手册 (Guide)」帮助按钮，轻点即可直达全功能用户手册的「编曲与钢琴卷帘 (Sequencer & Piano Roll)」专属章节，随时查阅音阶折叠、和弦印章、快捷键与高级编辑技巧，彻底打通工具操作与教学指导。
highlights.en: **Contextual Help Deep-Linking**: Added a dedicated "Guide" button to the right of Deck 1 that deep-links directly into the User Manual"s "Sequencer & Piano Roll" chapter, providing instant access to scale theory, chord stamping workflows, keyboard shortcuts, and power-user tips without losing editing context.

title.zh: v2.0.36 用户手册与交互式教学中心上线、移动端高级实验室与探索去重、钢琴卷帘交互式音阶选择与半音移调
title.en: v2.0.36 User Manual & Interactive Learning Center, Mobile Drawer De-duplication, Piano Roll Scale Selector & Semitone Transpose

highlights.zh: **用户手册与交互式教学中心（User Manual & Interactive Learning Center）**：全新上线完整知识库与交互式实操中心。集成 8 大手册章节（快速上手、交互教学、编曲与钢琴卷帘、混音与高级实验室、和弦与调式理论、工程导出与跨平台、疑难排障 FAQ、快捷键完整索引），支持全域实时关键词秒级检索；内置 5 门交互式实操课程（鼓机节奏与欧几里得律动、钢琴卷帘与和声琶音、硬件调音台与母带限制器、底鼓谐振解剖与声谱示波器、曲风工坊派生与云端链接分享），支持分步指引与「立即前往体验」一键联动跳转。
highlights.en: **User Manual & Interactive Learning Center**: Launched a comprehensive documentation center and interactive tutorial hub. Covers 8 structured sections (Quick Start, Interactive Lessons, Sequencer & Piano Roll, Mixing & Pro Labs, Harmony & Theory, Export & Integrations, FAQs, and Keyboard Shortcuts) with instant search filtering. Features 5 interactive step-by-step tutorials with forward/backward progression and 1-click action buttons connecting directly to Studio, Console, Analyzer, Kick Anatomy, and Genre Maker.

highlights.zh: **移动端高级实验室与探索菜单彻底去重（Mobile Menu De-duplication）**：彻底解决移动端菜单中「高级与实验室」与「探索」列表重复展示调音台、全景示波器和曲风工坊的混乱体验。清晰划分为「高级与实验室」（调音台、全景示波器、曲风工坊）与「探索」（节奏大师课、星系云团、水平演变轴、垂直时间轴），各视图唯一归属，并为移动端和桌面端提供醒目的用户手册直达入口。
highlights.en: **Mobile Drawer Navigation De-duplication**: Completely eliminated redundant entries where Console Desk, Acoustic Analyzer, and Custom Genre Maker appeared under both "Explore" and "Pro & Labs" in the mobile drawer. Navigational items are now strictly partitioned between Pro Labs and Musicology/Exploration without duplication, with prominent direct entry points for the User Manual.

highlights.zh: **钢琴卷帘交互式调式音阶选择器（Interactive Scale & Tonality Selector）**：将 Deck 1 被动音阶标签升级为全功能交互式调式音阶选择下拉框，内置大调、自然小调、多利亚、弗里几亚、利底亚、混合利底亚、洛克利亚、和声小调、旋律小调、全音阶、布鲁斯等 22 种音乐理论音阶；选择后实时刷新全半音阶网格自然音高亮与根音「ROOT」金色水印标牌，并同步影响和弦印章配置。
highlights.en: **Interactive Scale & Tonality Selector**: Replaced the passive scale badge in Deck 1 with an interactive dropdown supporting 22 theoretical scales and modes (Major, Minor, Dorian, Phrygian, Lydian, Mixolydian, Locrian, Harmonic/Melodic Minor, Blues, Pentatonic, etc.). Switching tonality immediately refreshes in-scale lanes, ROOT gold watermark badges, and chord voicings in real time.

highlights.zh: **半音微调（±1 Semitone Transpose）与光标音高十字准星**：在 Deck 2 工具栏引入升半音（+1）与降半音（−1）移调工具，选中音符后实时移调并伴随声学精准回放；指针在网格悬停时自动显示贯穿全小节的水平音高准星导轨，并与左侧 3D 黑白琴键实时高亮对齐，大幅提升微调与精细写作体验。
highlights.en: **Semitone Transposition (±1) & Pitch Guideline Crosshair**: Added +1 and −1 semitone transposition buttons in Deck 2 with live acoustic auditioning. Hovering anywhere on the grid displays a horizontal crosshair guideline aligned with the 3D keybed for effortless pitch tracking.

highlights.zh: **多音符和弦印章虚影光标预警（Multi-Note Chord Ghost Preview）**：在铅笔模式下开启和弦印章（三和弦、七和弦、九和弦、挂留和弦等）后，光标在空白网格悬浮时自动投射完整和弦堆叠的半透明虚影块，所见即所得，点击即可盖印完整和声音柱。
highlights.en: **Multi-Note Chord Ghost Preview**: When a chord stamp quality is selected (Triad, 7th, 9th, sus4, sus2, power), hovering over the canvas renders dashed ghost previews for all notes in the chord voicing prior to placement.

title.zh: v2.0.35 钢琴卷帘多小节全域网格质感重塑与琶音展开大师组：彻底消除黑屏死区、全半音阶白黑键分道底纹、调式根音金光徽标、一键解除循环全轨展开、和弦升降序琶音展开（Arp ▲/▼）与127极限力度动态标尺
title.en: v2.0.35 Piano Roll Unified Professional DAW Grid & Multi-Note Arpeggiator Suite: Blackout dead-zone elimination across all bars, natural/accidental key lane shading, scale root gold watermark badges, 1-click loop extension, multi-note arpeggiator (Arp ▲/▼), and 127 fff velocity dynamic markers

highlights.zh: **钢琴卷帘全小节网格质感重塑（Unified Professional DAW Grid Across All Bars）**：彻底修复多小节工程中首小节后网格反差断层、暗沉黑斑与线条不可见的视觉缺陷。网格底衬采用专业工作室海军深石板色调（#131624 与 #181c2e 优雅微反差交替），全半音阶自然白键行配备细腻透光层、半音黑键行采用经典钢琴黑曜石暗轨；调式根音行赋予温润金阳微光（rgba(245,158,11,0.13)）与小节起始「ROOT」金色水印徽标；16分音符与4分音符拍线贯穿全部小节，彻底消除空洞黑斑。
highlights.en: **Unified Professional DAW Grid Across All Bars**: Completely resolved the visual disparity where bars past Bar 1 appeared as an illegible black void. The grid canvas now features a sleek dark studio slate palette (#131624 and #181c2e subtle bar alternation), natural white key lanes with luminous highlights, and obsidian black key gutter rows. Scale root rows are illuminated with warm amber gradients and "ROOT" gold watermark badges, while crisp 16th and beat dividers span all bars seamlessly.

highlights.zh: **和弦升降序琶音即时展开（Multi-Note Arpeggiator Suite / Arp ▲ & Arp ▼）**：在 Deck 2 和弦编配区全新引入「琶音 ▲ (Arp ▲)」与「琶音 ▼ (Arp ▼)」工具。在网格中框选或点选任意复合和弦后，一键自动将静态叠音在时间线上按音高升序或降序分解平铺为连续步进琶音流水线条，并保持适当时值与独立编辑选区，极大解放键盘琶音与流水旋律的编曲生产力。
highlights.en: **Multi-Note Arpeggiator Suite (Arp ▲ & Arp ▼)**: Introduced dedicated "Arp ▲" and "Arp ▼" buttons in Deck 2. Selecting any chord stack and clicking an Arp button instantly unrolls block chords chronologically across consecutive steps in ascending or descending pitch order, turning static chords into fluid, rhythmic arpeggio runs with full undo support.

highlights.zh: **一键解除循环限制全轨展开（1-Click Track Loop Extension）**：针对独立循环长度短于工程总长的音轨，在网格循环导轨与标尺中增加直达交互标牌「展开全轨 (Extend Track)」。创作者无需反复进入设置或手动对齐，轻点即可将该轨循环长度安全扩充至工程全长，解锁全部小节的直接绘制与旋律发展。
highlights.en: **1-Click Track Loop Extension**: For tracks whose loop length was clamped below the project's total step count, an interactive "Extend Track" button is embedded in the loop boundary HUD. Creators can immediately expand the track loop to match the full song length with one click, unlocking full multi-bar sequencing freedom.

highlights.zh: **力度泳道 127 (fff) 动态标尺与步进气泡提示（Velocity Lane Dynamics & Tooltip Readouts）**：力度泳道纵轴补充 127 极强（fff · 127）最高动态参考刻度线，并与 96 (f)、64 (mf)、32 (p) 构成标准四段古典与现代音乐动力学网格；棒棒糖柱状控制器新增鼠标悬停浮动标牌（如 Step 1 · Velocity 100 (f)），精准显示步进序号与动态标记。
highlights.en: **Velocity Lane Dynamics & Tooltip Readouts**: Added the peak 127 dynamic guideline ("fff · 127") alongside Forte (96), Mezzo-Forte (64), and Piano (32). Each lollipop bar features responsive hover tooltips indicating exact step numbers and musical dynamic symbols.

highlights.zh: **工作台步进打击垫硬件质感同步进化**：工作台音序器步进单元格（StepCell）空闲底衬全面升级为硬派黑匣子机身质感（#131522 与 #181c2c 交替呈现），强化激活状态下的 LED 亚克力镜面高光与轨道主色反光，循环重复步进柔和透光，与钢琴卷帘形成高度一致的专业沉浸式创作界面。
highlights.en: **Studio Workbench StepCell Hardware Aesthetics**: Sequencer step cells now feature tactile matte slate pad finishes (#131522 and #181c2c alternating measures), enhanced LED acrylic specular reflections, and ambient track-colored blooms, harmonizing the entire workbench with the piano roll's professional aesthetic.

title.zh: v2.0.34 钢琴卷帘滑音试听与交互质感飞跃：琴键上下滑动试听（Glissando）、网格悬浮幽灵音符光标预警、Alt+滚轮即时微调力度、拖拽音长浮动HUD与首小节一键复刻（Dup B1）
title.en: v2.0.34 Piano Roll Keybed Glissando, Interactive Hover Cursors & Rhythmic Polish: Keybed drag-auditioning (glissando), ghost hover previews, Alt+wheel velocity nudging, floating note resize HUD, and 1-click Bar 1 duplication (Dup B1)

highlights.zh: **琴键上下滑动连续试听（Keybed Glissando / Drag-Auditioning）**：钢琴卷帘左侧象牙与黑曜石 3D 琴键槽全新支持连续滑音试听。按住鼠标或触控拖拽在键盘上快速上下掠过时，滑过的每个琴键均实时击发声学校准音符并点亮金黄热力图高光反馈，松开平滑归位，音域定位与和弦声部感知如行云流水。
highlights.en: **Piano Keybed Glissando & Drag-Auditioning**: Sweeping up and down the 3D ivory and obsidian pitch gutter keys with pointer down now triggers smooth acoustic glissando auditioning. Each key struck illuminates with a responsive golden heatmap glow and releases cleanly, providing effortless tactile pitch inspection.

highlights.zh: **网格鼠标悬浮幽灵音符与工具预警光标（Interactive Hover Ghost Cursor & Tool Targeting）**：铅笔工具模式下，指针移至网格任意空白位置自动投射半透明虚线幽灵预警音符（带微发光与音名/和弦印章角标），所见即所得；橡皮模式下悬浮目标音符显现实时红色脉冲警戒高光，剪刀模式下提供切割线预览，彻底消除盲目操作。
highlights.en: **Interactive Ghost Hover Cursor & Tool Targeting**: In pencil mode, hovering over any empty cell displays a translucent dashed ghost note preview showing the exact pitch name (or chord stamp name) and duration before clicking. The eraser mode highlights targeted notes with a pulsing red warning glow, and scissors mode renders precise split guides.

highlights.zh: **Alt + 滚轮即时微调音符力度（Alt + Mouse Wheel Velocity Nudge）**：鼠标悬停在任意音符上（或选中多音符）后，按住 Alt 键上下滚动滚轮即可直接以 ±5 步进微调音符力度，实时更新音符发光热力图并伴随微切片声学试听，界面顶部同步浮现数值 HUD 提示（如 Velocity: 105），指尖操作畅快淋漓。
highlights.en: **Alt + Mouse Wheel Velocity Nudge**: Hovering over any note or selecting multiple notes and scrolling with the Alt key instantly nudges velocity up or down by ±5. Dynamic heatmap colors update immediately, triggering acoustic velocity auditioning with a sleek HUD toast confirming the new value.

highlights.zh: **拉伸音符浮动时值 HUD 标牌（Floating Note Resize HUD）**：在指针工具下拉伸音符右边缘调整音长时，音符上方实时升起发光磨砂 HUD 气泡（如 Length: 1.50 steps），毫秒级精确反馈音符门限（Gate）时值，编配长和弦或短促断奏胸有成竹。
highlights.en: **Floating Note Resize HUD**: Dragging a note right-edge handle in pointer mode now projects a floating frosted HUD badge above the note (e.g. Length: 1.50 steps), displaying exact fractional gate steps in real time.

highlights.zh: **首小节旋律一键全曲复刻（Bar 1 Note Duplication / 📋 复制B1）**：在小节和弦走向标尺 Bar 1 标签旁及 Deck 2 工具栏中引入「📋 复制B1 (Dup B1)」功能。在首小节完成精彩旋律或低音线条后，一键自动平铺至后续所有小节，创作者可直接在此骨架上编排灵感变奏，大幅提升多小节工程编排效率。
highlights.en: **Bar 1 Note Duplication (Dup B1)**: Added a 1-click "Dup B1" button to both the Bar 1 ruler header and Deck 2 toolbar. Authoring a lead melody or bassline in Bar 1 can be instantly tiled across subsequent bars with one click, providing an instant foundation for multi-bar melodic variations.

title.zh: v2.0.33 钢琴卷帘调式音阶智能折叠（Fold）与快捷力度动态：Ableton/FL Studio 式音阶折叠、双击音符快速删除、音高拖动实时发声试听、4段力度快捷预设（p/mf/f/127）与平滑渐强（Ramp ↗）
title.en: v2.0.33 Piano Roll Scale Folding & Dynamic Articulation Suite: Ableton/FL Studio-style Fold to Scale, double-click note deletion, live pitch-drag acoustic auditioning, 4-tier velocity presets (p/mf/f/127), and smooth velocity ramp (Ramp ↗)

highlights.zh: **调式音阶智能折叠（Ableton/FL Studio 式 Fold to Scale）**：在钢琴卷帘 Deck 2 新增「Fold / 折叠」开关。开启后自动隐藏音阶外的冗余半音行，仅保留当前调式音阶内音高与已写入音符行，彻底释放小屏笔记本与移动触控设备的垂直空间，防止滑音误触跑调，专注和谐和弦与旋律编排；关闭折叠则完整呈现全半音阶网格。
highlights.en: **Smart Scale Folding (Ableton/FL Studio-style Fold to Scale)**: Added a dedicated "Fold" toggle button to Deck 2 of the piano roll. When engaged, out-of-scale chromatic pitch rows are folded away, leaving only in-scale notes and authored pitches. This eliminates vertical clutter on compact screens, prevents out-of-key note entry, and streamlines chord voicing.

highlights.zh: **双击音符即时删除与拖动音高实时试听（Double-Click Deletion & Live Pitch-Drag Auditioning）**：免切换工具即可实现双击（Double-Click）任意音符直接删除，操作体验对齐主流桌面 DAW；在网格拖动音符进行上下移调时，实时触发微切片声学校准试听，随着鼠标拖曳即时回放音高变化，给予创作者极具质感的即时声音反馈。
highlights.en: **Double-Click Note Deletion & Live Pitch-Drag Auditioning**: Double-clicking any existing note now removes it instantly without requiring tool switching. Dragging notes vertically across pitch rows triggers real-time acoustic auditioning as the note crosses row boundaries, providing instantaneous sonic feedback.

highlights.zh: **快捷力度动态工具组（Quick Dynamics Presets & Ramp ↗）**：在卷帘检视器中为选中音符新增即时力度预设（p · 40、mf · 80、f · 110、max · 127）以及「Ramp ↗」时间线线性平滑渐强工具，一键完成复杂小节内多音符的起伏力度塑形与律动编排。
highlights.en: **Quick Dynamics Presets & Ramp ↗**: Introduced instant velocity preset buttons (p · 40, mf · 80, f · 110, max · 127) and a smooth chronological "Ramp ↗" tool in the note inspector, allowing producers to sculpt rhythmic dynamics and crescendos across multi-note selections with a single click.

highlights.zh: **工作台步进音序器脚标与旋律音名高对比度优化**：更新工作台底部版本标牌至最新版本，步进单元格内旋律音名标签升级为高对比度立体投影质感（white drop-shadow），在各种亮暗鼓轨背景下均清晰可辨。
highlights.en: **Studio Workbench Versioning & Note Label Contrast**: Synchronized the sequencer panel footer to the current app version and updated StepCell melodic pitch text with high-contrast drop-shadows for crystal clarity across all track color palettes.

title.zh: v2.0.32 工作台与钢琴卷帘全链路创作体验与视觉重构：消除多小节卷帘黑屏遮挡、多小节交替明暗底色底纹、半透明虚线循环导轨与幽灵音符、暖阳琥珀热力图音符、6大 DAW 硬件指令舱与一键复制小节
title.en: v2.0.32 Studio Workbench & Piano Roll Arranger Workflow & Visual Overhaul: Multi-bar blackout elimination, alternating bar columns, non-blocking polymeter loop guide with ghost notes, warm radiant amber note heatmap, 6 DAW hardware pods, and 1-click bar duplication

highlights.zh: **钢琴卷帘多小节黑屏遮挡彻底消除（Elimination of Multi-Bar Piano Roll Blackout）**：彻底修复在 64 步（4 小节）等多小节工程中，因轨道循环长度（trackLength）触发粗暴的纯黑重叠遮罩导致第 1 小节后全网格变黑、网格线消失且指针点击被拦截的严重故障。卷帘网格现采用分层架构：底层跨全部 64 步平铺交替明暗小节底色（#10121b 与 #151926），小节与拍子网格线贯穿全长；循环导轨改为非阻断性半透明导轨（pointer-events-none + 细虚线高光与步数标牌），任何小节均清爽通透且可自由点按创作。
highlights.en: **Elimination of Multi-Bar Piano Roll Blackout**: Completely resolved a critical issue where multi-bar projects (e.g. 64 steps / 4 bars) with partial loop lengths triggered an opaque dark hatching overlay that blacked out the entire grid past Bar 1, hid all gridlines, and intercepted user mouse gestures. The piano roll grid now features layered alternating bar columns across all 64 steps, and the loop boundary is transformed into a non-blocking transparent guide (pointer-events-none with dashed gold divider and step badge), leaving all bars luminous and freely editable.

highlights.zh: **多小节循环幽灵音符呈现（Looped Repeat Ghost Notes）**：当旋律轨处于循环循环模式（如 16 步循环在 64 步走向下播放）时，卷帘第 2、3、4 小节自动根据模长呈现半透明虚线幽灵音符（Ghost Notes），不仅清晰展示当前后段小节的真实复响，还能配合吸附和弦走向标尺显示全局和弦徽标；用户在后段小节任意空白处点击，即可立即写入独立真实音符进行变奏创作。
highlights.en: **Looped Repeat Ghost Notes**: When a track loops polymetrically under a longer progression (e.g. 16 steps looping under 64 steps), bars 2..4 in the piano roll automatically render translucent dashed ghost notes indicating loop repetitions and display full chord progression badges. Clicking any empty cell in subsequent bars immediately authors a discrete note variation.

highlights.zh: **暖阳琥珀发光音符与 3D 象牙黑曜石琴键配色美化**：彻底告别原本发青偏暗的低对比度音符着色，重塑为基于标准 DAW 热力图的暖阳琥珀至亮珊瑚发光块体（hsl(18..45) 随力度自然延展），搭配顶部 2px 镜面反射弧边与左侧琴槌冲击瞬态线；左侧音高键盘升级为典雅象牙温润白键与多段黑曜石黑键，并赋予 C 音八度徽标；力度泳道同步配备交替小节底衬与发光棒棒糖圆头（Lollipop Heads）。
highlights.en: **Warm Radiant Amber Notes & 3D Ivory/Obsidian Keybed Aesthetics**: Replaced muddy greenish-cyan notes with a glowing DAW heatmap spanning radiant coral to blazing golden amber (hsl(18..45) with velocity dynamics), augmented by 2px top specular highlights and hammer transient strike edges. The pitch gutter features satin ivory and obsidian key textures with bold C-octave pills, and the velocity lane embeds matching alternating bar shading and luminous lollipop heads.

highlights.zh: **工作台 6 大硬件指令舱与小节一键复制（6 DAW Control Pods & Bar Duplication）**：顶部工具栏按专业音频工作站标准重构成 6 大磨砂玻璃硬件控制舱（主时钟舱、拍号网格舱、音色与模板舱、DAW 视图舱、创作工具舱、主控与 I/O 舱），BPM 步进器增加 ±1 微调按键；步进序列器各轨道行配备立体按压反馈与纯色静音/独奏渐变徽章，旋律轨高亮卷帘直达按钮；标尺表头新增「📋 复制 B1 (Dup B1)」一键复制首小节至全小节快捷动作，创作灵感一触即发。
highlights.en: **6 DAW Hardware Control Pods & 1-Click Bar Duplication**: Restructured the studio workbench toolbar into 6 dark frosted hardware control pods (Transport & Clock, Metre & Quantize, Sound & Pattern Slots, DAW Views & Editors, Creative Tools & History, I/O & Master Hub) with BPM micro-nudge buttons. Sequencer track rows feature tactile Mute/Solo button gradients, melodic track piano roll launchers, and a 1-click "Dup B1" header action to duplicate bar 1 across multi-bar patterns.

title.zh: v2.0.31 钢琴卷帘 Logic Pro 级专业美化与双层 DAW 指令台重构：模块化双层控制台、立体 3D 象牙与黑曜石琴键、调式级数钻石导轨、亚克力高光音符块、棒棒糖力度控制器与直达虚拟键盘演奏
title.en: v2.0.31 Logic Pro-Grade Piano Roll Visual & Command Architecture Overhaul: Modular 2-deck command deck, 3D ivory & obsidian keybed, scale degree guide rails, acrylic glass note blocks, lollipop velocity lane, and direct Musical Typing HUD integration

highlights.zh: **模块化双层 DAW 指令控制台（2-Deck Command Deck）**：重塑原本拥挤无序的单行工具栏，构建清晰专业的双层分级控制台。Deck 1 集成轨道上下文中心（轨道切换、调式音阶微标、动态音符计数）、胶囊型主工具箱（指针 1、铅笔 2、橡皮 3、剪刀 4、框选 5，带荧光激活高光与快捷键角标）、力度泳道/播放头追随/展开收起/全屏及专属「Keys ⌥K」虚拟键盘快捷入口；Deck 2 集成时间网格（吸附与长度量化）、连音（Legato）、和弦编配大师组（Note/Triad/7th/9th/Sus4/Power 印章、和弦转位 ▲/▼、Drop-2 声部排列、人性化微时序抖动）、音高八度跨度调节（±12、8va/8vb）与多级视区缩放。层次分明，操作行云流水。
highlights.en: **Modular 2-Deck DAW Command Deck**: Replaced the cluttered single-line toolbar with an ergonomically stratified 2-deck control chassis. Deck 1 houses the Track Context Hub (selector, scale/key badge, note counter), Primary Tool Palette (Pointer 1, Pencil 2, Eraser 3, Scissors 4, Marquee 5 with radiant glow states and shortcut badges), view toggles (Velocity, Catch, Collapse, Fullscreen), and a dedicated "Keys ⌥K" Musical Typing launcher. Deck 2 houses timing & quantize controls, legato, harmony authoring suite (chord stamping, inversions, Drop-2 voicing, humanize), pitch octave transposition (±12, 8va/8vb), and density zooms.

highlights.zh: **立体 3D 象牙与黑曜石键盘（3D Ivory & Obsidian Keybed）**：彻底告别简陋扁平色块。黑键采用多段黑曜石渐变（#101217 → #242833），顶部倒角反光与投射到白键上的自然阴影，指针按下时呈现发光下潜反馈；白键采用象牙瓷釉高质感微渐变，并标注醒目 C3/C4/C5 八度标牌；琴键右缘嵌入调式级数光导轨，根音显示脉动旋转菱形钻标（Diamond Pin），调内音显示精细珍珠圆标，键盘与网格行实现亚像素级严格对齐。
highlights.en: **3D Ivory & Obsidian Piano Keybed**: Overhauled the pitch gutter with authentic tactile depth. Ebony keys feature multi-stop obsidian gradients (#101217 to #242833), top bevel highlights, and cast drop shadows with interactive depression feedback; ivory keys feature creamy enamel finishes and prominent octave badges (C3, C4, C5); and the keybed margin embeds luminous scale degree guide pins (pulsing diamond pips for roots, pearl pips for diatonic tones) perfectly aligned with grid rows.

highlights.zh: **亚克力质感音符块与金属拉丝和弦走势标尺（Acrylic Glass Notes & Brushed Chord Ruler）**：网格音符升级为全圆角亚克力发光块体，顶部拥有细致的高光反射边缘（border-t border-white/60），左侧配备琴槌撞击瞬态标记（Hammer Transient Marker），并根据力度映射琥珀至亮珊瑚热力图渐变；顶部吸附小节线与和弦走向标尺采用金属拉丝风格，自动识别小节和弦徽章，轻点即可多音完整试听。
highlights.en: **Acrylic Glass Note Blocks & Brushed Chord Progression Ruler**: Pitch grid notes are elevated with acrylic glass capsules featuring top specular reflection rims, hammer strike transient impact lines, and velocity heatmap shading; the sticky timeline tape and chord progression ruler adopts a brushed dark metal texture, displaying harmonic badges that audition polyphonic chords upon clicking.

highlights.zh: **棒棒糖风格力度控制器与全局虚拟键盘联动（Lollipop Velocity Lane & Musical Typing Linkage）**：力度泳道升级为经典 DAW 棒棒糖发光柱体（Lollipop Stems），细杆顶端搭配随力度色彩动态响应的发光圆珠，辅以 32/64/96/127 分贝参考水平线；底部检视器支持数值精细步进，并与全局电脑键盘演奏系统（⌥K Musical Typing）深度联动，随时在卷帘内即兴演奏录入。
highlights.en: **Lollipop Velocity Controller & Musical Typing Integration**: The velocity lane now features iconic DAW lollipop stems with glowing circular heads color-matched to velocity heatmaps and horizontal reference guidelines (32, 64, 96, 127). The bottom inspector provides precise numeric editing and links directly to the Musical Typing HUD for seamless computer keyboard audition and input.

title.zh: v2.0.30 播放中切换曲风从头起播与视听试听全链路声学同步：切换时干净重置播放头并从第一拍开始、试听与详情页完整继承真实BPM/Swing/鼓机模型、WAV导出Swing倍率归一化
title.en: v2.0.30 Transport Playback Reset on Genre Switch & Audition Acoustic Fidelity: Clean playhead reset and restart from downbeat when switching genres during playback, audition & detail previews inherit authentic BPM/Swing/DrumKit, and WAV export swing normalization

highlights.zh: **播放中切换曲风从头开始播放（Transport Playback Restart on Downbeat）**：解决在序列器正在播放时切换曲风，新曲风半路承接上一曲风步进指针与拍子偏移的割裂感。现在切换曲风时检测若处于播放状态，自动执行 stop() 并彻底重置播放头（clearPlayhead()），随后从第 0 步/第一小节第 1 拍从头启动播放，保证新曲风节奏与和声从第一拍干净利落实时呈现。
highlights.en: **Transport Playback Reset on Genre Switch**: Resolved an issue where switching genres while the transport was running caused the new genre to resume from an arbitrary mid-bar step and phase offset. When switching during active playback, the engine now cleanly stops, resets the playhead via clearPlayhead(), and restarts from step 0 (downbeat of bar 1).

highlights.zh: **全站曲风试听与详情页声学全要素同步（Audition Acoustic Parity）**：修复悬浮试听（useGenreAudition）与曲风详情预览（GenreDetailView）未继承该曲风专属 BPM、Swing 与硬件鼓机模型的痛点。setPattern(..., resetStates = true) 现在自动同步曲风自带速度、Swing 微时序（支持百分比与 0..0.75 比例）以及真实鼓机型号（808/909/Acoustic/Cyber），在全站任意卡片试听 174 BPM Drum & Bass 或 35% 摇摆 Boom Bap 均能立即听到该曲风地道标志性的律动与音色。
highlights.en: **Audition Acoustic Parity**: Overhauled preview auditioning in hover cards and GenreDetailView to strictly adhere to authentic genre tempo, swing micro-timing, and drum machine models (808/909/Acoustic/Cyber) via setPattern(..., resetStates = true). Auditioning Drum & Bass at 174 BPM or Boom Bap with 35% swing immediately conveys the authentic acoustic groove.

highlights.zh: **WAV 离线导出 Swing 溢出归一化修复**：修复 WavExporter 在处理大于 1 的 Swing 百分比值（如 15% 或 35%）时未除以 100 进行比例归一化，导致直接被 Math.min(0.75, ...) 截断为极限摇摆 0.75 的声学缺陷。离线导出渲染现与实时音频引擎完全保持一致。
highlights.en: **WAV Offline Export Swing Normalization**: Corrected swing parsing in WavExporter to properly normalize percentage-based swing (> 1) by dividing by 100 before clamping to 0.75, eliminating acoustic distortion and achieving 100% parity with live playback.

title.zh: v2.0.29 钢琴卷帘专业编曲升级与电脑键盘演奏系统：多音和弦无损呈现与编辑、Logic 式 3D 琴键与和弦走向标尺、和弦印章/转位/Drop-2/人性化、Musical Typing 虚拟键盘 (⌥K)
title.en: v2.0.29 Professional Piano Roll Arranger Upgrade & Musical Typing Keyboard: Lossless polyphonic chord stacks, Logic-grade 3D keybed & chord progression ruler, chord stamps / inversions / Drop-2 / humanize, and Musical Typing HUD (⌥K)

highlights.zh: **钢琴卷帘真和弦多音堆叠与无损编曲**：彻底解决和弦在卷帘中坍缩为单音的痛点。当轨道为和弦轨且未固化音堆时，自动基于调式进行全音堆多音展开；在序列器状态机（SET_PITCH）中保持原有和弦堆叠结构或调式级数移调，禁止单音覆盖；新增 addChord 工具支持三和弦、七和弦、九和弦、挂留（Sus4/Sus2）及强力和弦一键输入，并支持和弦转位（▲ Inv / ▼ Inv）、爵士/流行 Drop-2 声部编配以及音符人性化微时序/力度抖动（Humanize）。
highlights.en: **Lossless Polyphonic Chord Stacks & Editing**: Completely resolved chord voice collapsing in the piano roll. Unexpanded chord steps are dynamically voiced with full polyphony; SET_PITCH maintains full multi-note stacks during transposition; and new chord authoring tools provide instant chord stamping (triads, 7ths, 9ths, sus, power), inversions (up/down), Drop-2 jazz/pop voicing, and humanize jitter.

highlights.zh: **Logic Pro 级高品质卷帘界面与走向标尺**：重塑钢琴卷帘视觉与交互质感。左侧琴键槽重构为立体 3D 黑白键盘（带圆润键尖、C 音高标记、调式级数光环与点击即时按压下潜发声试听）；音符块升级为带力度渐变热力图、左侧打击高光与亚克力玻璃质感的 DAW 块体，并在宽度合适时清晰印上 C4、E4 音名；顶部网格新增小节与和弦走向吸附标尺（Chord Progression Header），自动识别并展示和弦徽标（如 Bar 1 · Cmaj7），点击即可一键框选全小节所有音符。
highlights.en: **Logic-Grade 3D Piano Keybed & Progression Ruler**: Overhauled the piano roll visual architecture. The pitch gutter now features realistic 3D ivory/ebony keys with C-octave badges, scale indicators, and interactive pointer-down audition depression; note blocks feature velocity heatmap gradients, strike accents, and crisp pitch labels; and a sticky chord progression header automatically detects chord badges (e.g. Bar 1 · Cmaj7) with 1-click bar selection.

highlights.zh: **Musical Typing 电脑虚拟键盘演奏系统 (⌥K)**：为系统引入与 Web MIDI 键盘并行的完整电脑键盘演奏 HUD（快捷键 ⌥K / Alt+K，或通过工具栏键盘按钮一键呼出）。支持标准 Logic Pro 双八度键位映射（白键 A S D F G H J K L ; '，黑键 W E T Y U O P），集成八度升降（Z / X）、力度调节（C / V）、延音踩踏（Tab）、和弦模式（一键触发调式和声堆叠）与目标轨道即时切换，为无物理 MIDI 键盘的用户提供专业流畅的现场演奏与试听体验。
highlights.en: **Musical Typing Virtual Keyboard HUD (⌥K)**: Introduced a full-featured computer keyboard performance HUD alongside Web MIDI (toggle via ⌥K or toolbar button). Features standard Logic Pro 2-octave QWERTY mapping, octave shifting (Z/X), velocity scaling (C/V), sustain toggle (Tab), diatonic chord mode, and dynamic track routing for fluid real-time auditioning and musical performance.

highlights.zh: **单轨查看器与轨道行卷帘一键精准直达**：在每个轨道行（TrackRow）的操作区新增直接打开钢琴卷帘按钮（Music2 图标），用户轻点该轨即可直接展开对应轨道的钢琴卷帘，彻底消除此前在查看器中偶尔需要二次手动切换轨道的困扰。
highlights.en: **Direct Track-to-Roll Routing**: Added a dedicated piano roll button to every TrackRow, allowing 1-click opening of the piano roll lane pre-focused on the selected track without requiring secondary navigation.

title.zh: v2.0.28 步进序列器视听长度全小节对齐与读写一致性：消除扩展小节黑屏失真、步进/力度泳道全小节发声呈现、多小节循环读写双向同步、钢琴卷帘扩充保护
title.en: v2.0.28 Sequencer Visual and Audio Length Parity Across Looped Bars: Eliminated blacked-out bars on expanded patterns, synchronized StepCell & VelocityLane display with audio engine playback, enabled bi-directional multi-bar loop edit parity, and protected piano roll note extensions

highlights.zh: **步进网格视听长度一致性（Visual and Audio Length Parity）**：修复 64/128 步多小节走向下，鼓组与贝斯轨因 trackLength 限制导致第 2、3、4 小节被误判为 isOutsideLoop 而呈现黑屏变暗、光标禁用（cursor-not-allowed）且无法点击交互，但后台音频却在持续循环发声的严重视听割裂问题。expandGenrePattern 现在为所有扩展步进完整复制旋律与节奏数据，步进单元格支持 isLoopedRepeat 循环高亮渲染，使整个步进网格显示与播放声音长度 100% 吻合。
highlights.en: **Visual and Audio Length Parity**: Fixed a severe visual/audio disconnect where drum and bass tracks in 64/128-step patterns were dimmed, blacked out, and rendered with cursor-not-allowed on bars 2..4 due to false isOutsideLoop suppression while the audio engine looped and played them continuously. expandGenrePattern now populates repeating pattern data across all pattern steps, and StepCell introduces isLoopedRepeat active styling matching live sound.

highlights.zh: **状态机循环步进读写双向同步（Bi-directional Loop Edit Synchronization）**：在 useSequencerStore 状态机（SET_STEP、SET_VELOCITY、SET_PITCH、SET_GATE、SET_RATCHET、SET_PROBABILITY）以及桌面拖拽批量绘制（useGridInteraction）中，引入循环步进模长双向同步机制。当轨道处于循环模式时，在任意小节点击或涂画步进，自动同步更新所有循环副本与发声音符，保证显示、编辑、试听、播放与导出全部使用同一份严格同步的数据。
highlights.en: **Bi-directional Loop Edit Synchronization**: Implemented modulo-based loop synchronization in useSequencerStore actions (SET_STEP, SET_VELOCITY, SET_PITCH, SET_GATE, SET_RATCHET, SET_PROBABILITY) and desktop drag painting (useGridInteraction). Editing steps or velocity bars in any bar immediately synchronizes across all loop iterations, ensuring display, editing, audition, playback, and export operate on the exact same state.

highlights.zh: **力度泳道全小节实时联动与卷帘扩充保护（Velocity Lane & Piano Roll Extension Parity）**：VelocityLane 现在自动派生循环步进的力度/概率/时值/切分值并直观呈现所有小节，通过接入 subscribePlayhead 实现高帧率零重渲染的激光播放头全小节平滑滚动；在钢琴卷帘 withTrackNotes 中增加跨小节绘制自动扩容保护，防止用户在后段小节绘制的新音符被旧循环长度截断失声。
highlights.en: **Velocity Lane Real-time Parity & Piano Roll Extension**: VelocityLane now derives values across all bars and subscribes to subscribePlayhead for 60fps playhead tracking without React re-renders. withTrackNotes automatically expands trackLength when users draw notes in subsequent bars so custom melodies are never silently muted by playback.

title.zh: v2.0.27 钢琴卷帘与和弦数据全链路一致性同步：查看器精准映射打开轨道、卷帘真和弦堆叠呈现与编辑、MIDI/Ableton 导出真和弦音符多音对齐
title.en: v2.0.27 Piano Roll and Chord Data Synchronization: Inspector target track accuracy, true chord stack rendering & editing, and multi-note export parity for MIDI and Ableton Live Sets

highlights.zh: **查看器打开卷帘精准定向（Track Inspector Target Track Binding）**：修复在任意轨道查看器（TrackInspector）点击「打开钢琴卷帘」时被硬编码逻辑无条件重定向到首个旋律轨（贝斯）的问题。现在精准透传当前检查的轨道索引，并在卷帘轨选择器中支持当前轨道显示，无论在和弦、主音、贝斯或打击乐查看器打开，卷帘均忠实展示该轨对应内容。
highlights.en: **Target Track Binding**: Fixed an issue where clicking "Open Piano Roll" in TrackInspector unconditionally redirected to the first melodic track (bass). Now precisely binds and displays the inspected track index in both the piano roll lane and selector.

highlights.zh: **和弦卷帘多音真实堆叠与读写双向同步**：在卷帘模型中为和弦轨引入调式 voicing 兜底，消除和弦轨在未固化音堆时只显示单音的缺陷；解决 React key 冲突警告；在序列器状态机（SET_PITCH / BATCH_SET_PITCH）中引入音堆与根音的同步移调约束，确保卷帘编辑、网格修改与音高变动时 pitch（根音）与 pitches（全音堆）始终保持严格一致。
highlights.en: **True Chord Stack Rendering & Bi-directional State Sync**: Notes in the piano roll now synthesize full chord voicings even when unexpanded; resolved React child key collision warnings; synchronized pitch (root) and pitches (stack) in reducer actions (SET_PITCH / BATCH_SET_PITCH) to ensure seamless data coherence across the UI.

highlights.zh: **导出端全音符多音对齐与单步试听对齐**：彻底移除 MidiExporter 与 AbletonExporter 之前写死的伪小三和弦（+0, +3, +7）硬编码，统一调用 track.pitches 与 chordNotesForStep 生成真和弦 MIDI 事件；同时在步进网格点击试听时传递 stepIdx，使网格点击试听、序列器实时播放、WAV 离线渲染、MIDI 导出与 Ableton 工程导出全部使用完全同一份真和弦数据。
highlights.en: **Exporters & Audition Parity**: Replaced hardcoded minor triad offsets in MidiExporter and AbletonExporter with true note stacks derived from track.pitches and chordNotesForStep. Grid audition now receives stepIdx to audition the exact stored chord stack, achieving 100% data fidelity across editing, auditioning, live playback, WAV export, MIDI export, and Ableton export.

title.zh: v2.0.26 工作台工具栏渐进呈现与浮动面板优化：88px 高级控制抽屉重构为自适应悬浮 Popover，点击外部或 Esc 快捷收起，消除小屏网格挤压与垂直跳动
title.en: v2.0.26 Studio toolbar progressive disclosure: Advanced Controls reconstructed into a floating popover with click-outside and Escape dismiss, eliminating grid squishing and vertical jumps on small displays

highlights.zh: **高级控制栏浮动化改造（Floating Popover Overlay）**：将原本占用文档流排版的 88px 高级控制抽屉改造成自适应悬浮 Popover（带 `z-40`、`backdrop-blur-md` 与柔和阴影），展开时不再向下推挤下方步进网格与轨道列表，小屏笔记本（1366×768 / 1440×900）上 8 轨序列器垂直空间始终稳定完整呈现。
highlights.en: **Floating Popover Overlay**: Converted the in-flow 88px advanced controls drawer into an anchored floating popover with `z-40`, backdrop blur, and 2xl shadow. Toggling advanced controls no longer pushes down or squishes the sequencer grid on compact laptop screens.

highlights.zh: **轻量交互与失焦收起**：为高级控制悬浮面板接入 `useRef` 点击外部与 `Escape` 键盘事件侦听，调节 Swing、总线滤波截止频率或 GS-1 开关后，只需轻点网格任意处或按 Esc 即可自然关闭，符合专业 DAW 浮动检查器交互直觉。
highlights.en: **Click-Outside & Escape Dismiss**: Added natural dismissal listeners to close the advanced panel when clicking anywhere outside or pressing Escape, matching professional DAW overlay workflows.

highlights.zh: **顶部主工具栏间距紧凑化**：将 Tier 1 顶部工具栏垂直边距紧凑化优化至 `pb-2 mb-1.5`，保证所有核心操作项（播放/停止、BPM、拍号、精度、小节导航、撤销/重做）整齐保持在舒适高度内，并通过自动化测试断言浮动层级与事件销毁。
highlights.en: **Toolbar Compaction**: Tightened vertical spacing to keep the Tier 1 toolbar streamlined, ensuring transport and timing controls fit comfortably without layout thrashing.

title.zh: v2.0.25 声学动态与音质增强：开闭镲物理阻尼互斥切音（Hi-Hat Choke Group）与底鼓对贝斯低频瞬态闪避（Sidechain Ducking）落地，实时与离线导出声学一致
title.en: v2.0.25 Acoustic dynamics & fidelity: Physical Hi-Hat Choke Group and Kick-Bass Low-End Sidechain Ducking implemented with live and export parity

highlights.zh: **Hi-Hat Choke Group 阻尼互斥切音**：遵循声学架子鼓镲片物理闭合特性与经典鼓机（TR-808/909）Exclusive Choke Group 机制，在 `AudioEngine` 与 `WavExporter` 中建立开闭镲联动状态。当闭镲（或 ratchet 滚奏）触发时，对处于振动衰减尾音的开镲施加 3ms 快速无爆音指数阻尼释音，彻底消除开闭镲重叠导致的脏乱高频混叠。
highlights.en: **Hi-Hat Choke Group**: Modeled after acoustic hi-hat pedal mechanics and Roland TR-808/909 exclusive choke groups. When a closed hi-hat or ratchet triggers, ringing open hi-hat voices are smoothly choked with a 3ms clickless exponential release ramp in both `AudioEngine` and `WavExporter`.

highlights.zh: **底鼓对贝斯低频闪避（Kick/Bass Sidechain Ducking）**：为解决 40–100Hz 次低频与超低频相位干涉和频率掩蔽难题，在通道条插入链与推子之间加入独立的 `duckGain` 动态闪避节点。每当底鼓音符触发时，贝斯通道自动按底鼓力度产生 ~-3dB 的精细瞬态下潜并在 65ms 内平滑恢复，显著提升整个混音底部的下潜凝聚力与瞬态打击感。
highlights.en: **Kick/Bass Low-End Sidechain Ducking**: Integrated a dedicated `duckGain` stage on channel strips before the volume fader. Triggering a kick transient dips bass channels by ~-3dB with an instant 3ms attack and smooth 65ms exponential release to resolve low-end frequency masking.

highlights.zh: **全流程离线导出对齐与单元验证**：离线渲染器 `WavExporter` 同步接入切音追踪与低频闪避算法，保证用户导出的 WAV 音频与浏览器实时监听具备 100% 的声学一致性，并通过新建的 `acousticEnhancements.test.ts` 严格断言。
highlights.en: **Full Export Parity & Test Suite**: The offline `WavExporter` implements identical choke group and sidechain ducking algorithms to maintain 100% acoustic parity with the live Web Audio engine, verified with new unit tests.

title.zh: v2.0.24 通道条动态扩充（支持 24/32 轨并入混音链）、子引擎（大师课与底鼓解剖）限幅器保护与移动端导航补齐
title.en: v2.0.24 Dynamic channel strip expansion (24/32-track mixing chain support), sub-engine limiter protection (Masterclass & Kick Anatomy) and mobile drawer navigation completion

highlights.zh: **通道条动态按需扩充**：针对 CompareView 24 轨与 32 轨复杂工程，`AudioEngine` 的通道条分配机制由原本写死的 16 轨动态扩充至 `Math.max(16, pattern.tracks.length)`。`setPattern` 切换大型工程时自动扩容补全缺失通道条并保证插入效果链与声像节点正确建立，彻底修复之前超过 16 轨的伴奏与对比轨道绕过通道条混音链路的问题。
highlights.en: **Dynamic channel strip allocation**: Expanded `AudioEngine` channel strips from hardcoded 16 to dynamically allocate `Math.max(16, pattern.tracks.length)` to support CompareView's 24 and 32-track projects. Switching patterns dynamically expands missing strips and attaches their insert effects and panners, resolving the previous issue where tracks past strip 16 bypassed channel strip processing.

highlights.zh: **子引擎限幅保护**：为独立运行的 `MasterclassAudioEngine`（调音大师课音频引擎）与 `AnatomyKickEngine`（底鼓解剖引擎）接入 `MasterLimiter` 动态限幅防护链路，并在销毁时显式释放限幅器与音频上下文，彻底杜绝大师课多轨示范与多层底鼓合成测试中的数字破音与削波失真风险。
highlights.en: **Sub-engine limiter protection**: Wired `MasterLimiter` dynamically to `MasterclassAudioEngine` and `AnatomyKickEngine` to guard against digital clipping during multi-track demonstrations and layered kick synthesis, and properly disposed resources in `destroy()`.

highlights.zh: **移动端抽屉导航补全**：在顶部导航栏（`Header.tsx`）的移动端折叠抽屉菜单中，补齐了遗漏的「调音台」（`/console`）、「全景声谱分析仪」（`/analyzer`）与「曲风制作工坊」（`/maker`）快捷路由跳转，移动端体验与桌面端保持完全一致。
highlights.en: **Mobile drawer navigation complete**: Added missing routes for Console (`/console`), Spectral Analyzer (`/analyzer`), and Genre Maker (`/maker`) to the mobile slide-out drawer menu in `Header.tsx`.

title.zh: v2.0.23 和弦真正落地：159 个曲风各自的和弦类型/音域/按 BPM 换算的音长/演奏法，琶音与分解写成真音符；pattern 长度按走向可变（16/32/64/128），没内容的轨道保持空
title.en: v2.0.23 Chords are real now: every one of the 159 genres gets its own chord quality, register, tempo-derived length and articulation, arpeggios and broken chords are written as real notes, pattern length varies with the progression (16/32/64/128), and tracks a genre does not use stay empty

highlights.zh: **先说清问题的性质**：声音里其实已经在用和弦（`chordVoicing` 会在播放时按曲风展开 voicing），但**数据模型每步只能存一个音高**（`pitch?: (number|null)[]`），和弦只在播放的一瞬间存在、不落进 pattern。所以钢琴卷帘只能显示单音，你也看不见、改不了和弦；音长与演奏法同样没有位置。这一版把它变成**真数据**。
highlights.en: **The nature of the problem first:** chords were already sounding (`chordVoicing` expanded a voicing per genre at playback), but the **data model held one pitch per step** (`pitch?: (number|null)[]`), so a chord existed only for the instant it was played and never in the pattern. The piano roll could therefore only show single notes, and neither the harmony nor its lengths and articulation had anywhere to live. This release turns them into **real data**.

highlights.zh: **三步地基**：① `SequencerTrack` 新增 **`pitches`**（每步一组音），`pitch` 保留为**根音**，旧工程/分享链接照旧可用；② 实时引擎与导出都改成**照存的音堆弹**（新增共享的 `chordNotesForStep`，有存就用、没有才自动 voicing），因此「卷帘所见 = 耳朵所听」是结构保证；③ 卷帘的音符标识从 `stepIdx` 改为 **(step, midi)**，和弦在卷帘里是**可显示、可逐音编辑**的音堆（画在已发声的步上会**加入和弦**，橡皮删单个音、⌥ 擦清整步，和弦可整体拖动、⌥ 拖动复制）。
highlights.en: **Three foundation steps.** (1) `SequencerTrack` gained **`pitches`** (a note stack per step) while `pitch` stays the **root**, so old projects and share links keep working. (2) The live engine and the exporter both play a **stored stack verbatim** (through a new shared `chordNotesForStep`; automatic voicing happens only when nothing is stored), which makes "what the roll shows is what you hear" structural rather than aspirational. (3) The roll's note identity changed from `stepIdx` to **(step, midi)**, so a chord is a stack that can be displayed and edited tone by tone: drawing onto a sounding step **adds to the chord**, the eraser removes one tone (⌥ clears the step), and a chord drags or ⌥-copies as a group.

highlights.zh: **时值上限的根因**：「有 1 拍的、也有多拍的」原本**做不到**——`gate` 被三处各自夹在 2 步（卷帘模型、卷帘 UI、MIDI/Ableton 导出、分享链接写入器），而引擎本身只是 `stepDur * gate`，从不需要这个小上限。现在统一用共享的 `MAX_NOTE_GATE_STEPS = 16`（1/16 下正好一小节），于是 pad 与小节级和弦是**一个长音**而不是十六个连起来的重复音。
highlights.en: **Why multi-beat lengths were impossible:** `gate` was independently clamped to 2 steps in four places (the roll model, the roll UI, the MIDI/Ableton exporters, the share-link writer) even though the engine only ever does `stepDur * gate` and never needed a small cap. They now share `MAX_NOTE_GATE_STEPS = 16` (one bar at 1/16), so a pad or a whole-bar chord is **one long note** rather than sixteen tied retriggers.

highlights.zh: **逐曲风内容：156 条覆盖**（`GENRE_EXPRESSION_GENERATED`，与手写表分开保留来源）。规则表沿用本仓库既有写法：**6 个类别档 + 逐曲风覆盖 + 必填理由**，未知/自建曲风只继承所属类别档。每条覆盖给出：和弦性质（三/七/power/sus/quartal/extended）、演奏法（柱式/扫弦/**琶音**/**分解**/短促/延音）、**按拍**的音长与走向占几小节、音域偏移、琶音速率，以及有特点的轨道乐句规则（连音/断奏/延音/幽灵音/ratchet）。八个并行作者按类别编写（Electronic 93 拆三份 + Rock/Metal 17 + Hip Hop 11 + Jazz/Blues 14 + Pop/R&B 13 + Latin/World 11），合并器 `scripts/merge_expression_parts.mjs` 逐条校验：不存在的曲风 id、缺理由、数值越界、琶音缺速率、role/ratchet 误用、跨文件重复、不存在的 progressionId——**它当场抓出我编造的两个 id**（`trap`/`gospel` → 真实为 `trap-rap`/`soul`）。
highlights.en: **The content: 156 per-genre overrides** (`GENRE_EXPRESSION_GENERATED`, kept separate from the hand-written table so provenance stays visible). The rule table follows the project's existing convention: **six category profiles + per-genre overrides + a required reason**, with unknown or user-created genres inheriting only their own category. Each override states the chord quality (triad/seventh/power/sus/quartal/extended), the articulation (block/strum/**arpeggio**/**broken**/stab/sustain), the length **in beats** and how many bars the progression occupies, the register, the arpeggio rate, and phrase rules for the tracks that have character (legato/staccato/sustain/ghost/ratchet). Eight authors worked per category in parallel (Electronic's 93 split three ways, plus Rock/Metal 17, Hip Hop 11, Jazz/Blues 14, Pop/R&B 13, Latin/World 11); `scripts/merge_expression_parts.mjs` validates every entry — unknown genre ids, missing reasons, out-of-range values, arpeggios without a rate, misused roles/ratchets, duplicate ids across files, unknown progression ids — and **it caught two ids I had invented** (`trap`/`gospel`, really `trap-rap`/`soul`).

highlights.zh: **生成器（纯函数，幂等）**：加载曲风时把作者写的**根音与和弦落点**展开成真音符——和弦写成 `pitches` 音堆、**琶音/分解写成真正的音符**（按你的决定：卷帘可见可改、导出天然一致）、循环类轨道保留作者长度并写 `trackLength` 让 16 步鼓组在 64/128 步走向下自动复行。两条保护：**和弦时值以「到下一个和弦的距离」为上限**（否则 4 拍的和弦会盖住后继和弦、把走向糊掉——第一版如此，被测试抓出）；**已展开或用户改过的和弦轨直接原样返回**（第一版会把琶音当「每步一个和弦」重写，冲掉用户编辑，也被测试抓出）。
highlights.en: **The generator** (pure and idempotent) expands the authored **roots and chord marks** into real notes when a genre loads: stacks in `pitches`, **arpeggios and broken chords as real notes** (your decision: visible and editable in the roll, and export-identical because nothing is expanded at playback any more), and looping tracks keep their authored length as `trackLength` so a 16-step drum part repeats under a 64/128-step progression. Two guards: a chord's length is capped by **the distance to the next chord** (a 4-beat chord written where the harmony moves every beat otherwise smothers its successor — the first version did exactly that, and a test caught it), and a chords track that is **already expanded or edited is returned untouched** (the first version rewrote an arpeggio as a stack per note and would have discarded the user's edits — also caught by a test).

highlights.zh: **你要的两条规矩由测试守住**：① **没内容的轨道保持空**——作者没写和弦的 21 个曲风（ghetto-house、minimal-techno、death-metal、electro…）一根音都不加，FX 之类的轨道从不被发明（第一版生成器把它们全填上了，违反你的要求）；② **和弦必须真的是和弦**——柱式/短促/延音类必须有 ≥3 音的**纵向**音堆，而琶音/分解类是**横向**陈述同一和声（32 个曲风属于此类），所以判据是「≥3 个不同音高」而不是「必须有音堆」（第一版测试判据用错，冤枉了琶音曲风）。
highlights.en: **The two rules you set are held by tests.** (1) **A track with nothing in it stays empty**: the 21 genres whose author wrote no chords (ghetto-house, minimal-techno, death-metal, electro, …) get no notes at all, and an `fx`-style track is never invented (the first version of the generator filled all of them, against your instruction). (2) **A chord has to be a chord**: block/stab/sustain genres must show a **vertical** stack of three or more notes, while arpeggio and broken-chord genres state the same harmony **horizontally** (32 genres are in that group) — so the criterion is "three or more distinct pitches" rather than "must have a stack", which is what the first version of the test wrongly demanded.

highlights.zh: **pattern 长度按走向决定，并相应把上限提到 128**：4 小节走向 64 步、8 小节 128 步（工具栏新增 128 选项，分享链接上限同步从 64 提到 128）。全库检查确认长度**确实不唯一**（你要求「每个曲风长度可以不一致」），且每轨长度与 pattern 长度一致。
highlights.en: **Pattern length follows the progression, and the ceiling moved to 128**: a four-bar progression is 64 steps and an eight-bar one 128 (a 128 option was added to the toolbar and the share-link cap moved from 64 to 128 with it). A library-wide check confirms the lengths genuinely **differ** — you asked for per-genre lengths — and that every track agrees with its pattern's length.

highlights.zh: **证据**：新增/更新单测——`genreExpression`（23 条：长度策略与 3/4、6/8 换算、罗马数字与调内定位、音堆/琶音/分解/stab 写法、性质决定堆叠宽度、时值上限、和弦不越过后继、循环轨 trackLength、空轨恒空、乐句规则、确定性、幂等、全库规则可用性与理由完整性）、`genreChordsLibrary`（**跑全部 159 个曲风**：每个有和弦的曲风都产出真和弦、长度受支持且不唯一、无时值越界、空轨恒空、加载确定）、`rollModel` 46 条（和弦契约）、卷帘组件 35 条，以及 7 端 E2E 的和弦检查（在卷帘往已发声的步再画一个音 → 出音堆且**步进网格步数不变**）。过程中 E2E 自己也暴露三处判据问题并已修：marquee 矩形改成**锚定真实音符**（pattern 变长后固定比例矩形可能一个音都框不到）、拖动限制在**同一行内**（marquee 按格选择，越一行就会多选）、连音改用**音符自身的 gate 值**判断（64/128 步时一格约 8px，用像素宽度等于在测缩放级别）。
highlights.en: **Evidence**: new and updated tests — `genreExpression` (23: length policy and 3/4 & 6/8 arithmetic, roman numerals and placement in the key, stack/arpeggio/broken/stab writing, quality determining stack width, the note-length cap, chords never overrunning the next one, `trackLength` for loopers, empty tracks staying empty, phrase rules, determinism, idempotence, and library-wide usability + reason completeness), `genreChordsLibrary` (**all 159 genres**: every genre with chords produces real ones, lengths are supported and not uniform, nothing exceeds the length cap, silent tracks stay silent, loading is deterministic), the 46 roll-model tests (the chord contract) and the 35 roll component tests, plus the 7-target E2E chord check (draw onto a sounding step → a stack appears while the **step grid's step count is unchanged**). The E2E also exposed three of its own faulty criteria, all fixed: the marquee rectangle now **anchors on a real note** (a fixed fraction of the viewport could enclose nothing once patterns got long), the drag is confined **to one row** (the marquee selects whole cells), and legato is judged on the notes' **own gate values** (at 64/128 steps a cell is ~8 px, so a pixel-width assertion would be testing the zoom level).

highlights.zh: **诚实说明**：① 和弦**位置与音域**是规则决定的（根音来自作者写的和弦落点与调式），不是逐个曲风手工写死的具体音符表；要逐音微调可以在卷帘里直接改，改过之后生成器不会再覆盖。② 演奏法里的 **strum 仍是引擎的起音错开**（和弦音在同一格，攻击错位由 articulation 提供），因为数据模型没有子步位置——琶音/分解则如你所选写成了真音符。③ 音长按拍换算依赖 pattern 的 resolution 与拍号（3/4、6/8 已覆盖，6/8 记 3 个四分拍）。④ 慢轨（响度/音色基线重录）按约定交给快机器，本版已启动并将在完成后补上。
highlights.en: **Honest limitations.** (1) Chord **position and register** come from rules (the root from the authored chord mark and the pattern's key) rather than a hand-written note table per genre; tone-by-tone tweaks are made in the roll, and the generator will not overwrite them afterwards. (2) **Strum** remains the engine's onset stagger (the chord tones share a step; the attack offset comes from the articulation), because the data model has no sub-step position — arpeggios and broken chords, as you chose, are written as real notes. (3) Length arithmetic depends on the pattern's resolution and time signature (3/4 and 6/8 are handled; 6/8 counts three quarter-note beats). (4) The slow track (re-recording the loudness/timbre baselines) runs on the faster machine by agreement; it has been started and will be filled in when it completes.

title.zh: v2.0.22 钢琴卷帘按 Logic 重做：力度泳道、五种工具、框选与成组编辑、量化/连音、音阶高亮、播放头跟随
title.en: v2.0.22 The piano roll is rebuilt against Logic: velocity lane, five tools, marquee and group editing, quantise/legato, scale highlighting and playhead catching

highlights.zh: **力度泳道**（Logic 的标志性部件）：网格下方每个音符一根竖条，条高就是力度；拖动一根改那个音符，拖动的条若属于当前选区则**整段选区一起偏移**。绘制音符的颜色也随之变化（暗石板 → 亮琥珀），所以力度不用读数字也能看出来。
highlights.en: **A velocity lane** — Logic's signature component: one vertical bar per note under the grid, its height being the velocity. Dragging a bar edits that note, and dragging a bar that belongs to the selection offsets **the whole selection**. Note colours follow velocity too (dim slate → bright amber), so the dynamics are visible without reading numbers.

highlights.zh: **五种工具**：铅笔（默认）、指针、橡皮、剪刀、框选——按钮 + 键盘 `1`–`5`。铅笔还会**涂画**：按住拖过空格会连续写音符，整笔**只算一次撤销**。**与 Logic 不同的两处，都是刻意的**：① 默认工具是铅笔而不是指针——这个编辑器的第一动作是往空网格里画（重建前它也只有这一种行为），而 Logic 的钢琴卷帘主要是编辑已有片段；② 剪刀需要**右侧有空位**才能把长音符切成两个（步进网格是单声部的，没有地方放重叠音符），切不了时**弹提示说明原因**，而不是静默无动作。
highlights.en: **Five tools** — pencil (the default), pointer, eraser, scissors, marquee — as buttons and keys `1`–`5`. The pencil also **paints**: holding and dragging across empty cells keeps writing notes, and the whole stroke is **one undo step**. Two deliberate departures from Logic: (1) the default tool is the pencil, not the pointer, because this editor's first act is drawing into an empty grid (and before this rebuild that was its only behaviour), whereas Logic's piano roll mostly edits existing regions; (2) the scissors need a **free slot to the right** to cut a long note into two — a step grid is monophonic, so there is nowhere to put an overlapping note — and when it cannot cut it **says why** instead of silently doing nothing.

highlights.zh: **框选与成组编辑**：拖框（指阵/框选工具）选中一批音符，成组拖动（同时改时间与音高）、**⌥ 拖动复制**、Delete 删除、方向键微移、⌘A 全选；每一次手势**只提交一次**（一条撤销），这是我在实现里专门保证的不变量。选中音符会显示白色描边与计数，右下角是可直接输入的音符检视器（音高 / 起点 / 时长 / 力度），改任一项即提交。
highlights.en: **Marquee and group editing**: drag a rectangle (pointer or marquee tool) to select notes, then move the group in time and pitch together, **⌥-drag to copy**, Delete to remove, arrow keys to nudge, ⌘A to select all — each gesture committing **once** (one undo step), an invariant the implementation protects. Selected notes get a white outline and a count, and the footer is a numeric note inspector (pitch / start / length / velocity) that commits on any edit.

highlights.zh: **量化与连音——按步进网格如实改写**。Logic 的「量化起点」在这里**没有意义**（起点本来就是整数步），所以我没有放一个按了没反应的按钮，而是提供真正会变的那两件事：**量化长度**（把时长吸附到吸附值，如 `1/16`、`1/4`，可选 `自由`）与**连音**（把每个选中音符延到下一个音符的起点，必要时封顶到引擎的两步上限）。连音**也可能把音符变短**——那正是连音的定义，UI 文案如实写着。吸附选择器（`自由/1/4/1/8/1/16/1/32`）同时作用于画与拖。
highlights.en: **Quantise and legato, rewritten honestly for a step grid.** Logic's "quantise start" is **meaningless here** (starts *are* integer steps), so rather than shipping a button that does nothing, the two things that can actually drift are offered: **quantise lengths** (snap durations to the snap value — `1/16`, `1/4`, or free) and **legato** (extend each selected note to the next note's start, capped at the engine's two-step maximum). Legato **can also shorten** a note — that is what legato means, and the UI says so. The snap selector (`free / 1/4 / 1/8 / 1/16 / 1/32`) applies to both drawing and dragging.

highlights.zh: **视觉按 DAW 的路子重做**：左侧音高栏画成**键盘**（黑键有底色），并按调式**高亮音阶**（根音最强、调内次之、调外压暗，`data-scale` 可断言）；网格行同样着色，小节线加重并标小节号；音符在宽度够时**直接写出音名**（按格子宽度决定，不按音符自身宽度——否则缩小时会闪烁）；循环区尾部压暗；右边缘有**改时长的拖柄**；行高可三档切换（纵向缩放）以配合横向缩放。
highlights.en: **The visuals follow DAW conventions**: the pitch gutter is drawn as a **keyboard** (black keys shaded) and **highlights the scale** (root strongest, in-scale next, out-of-scale darkened, assertable through `data-scale`); the grid rows are shaded the same way; bar lines are heavier and numbered; notes **print their name** when the cells are wide enough (decided by the *cell* width, not the note's own width, which would flicker while zooming); the region past the loop end is darkened; the right edge carries a **length drag handle**; and the row height has three steps (vertical zoom) to go with the horizontal one.

highlights.zh: **播放头与跟随**：卷帘的播放头**走 DOM 总线而不是 React 状态**（新增 `playheadBus`）——一拍十六分之一的步进若每次都重渲染，正是之前那批「卡顿」修复要消掉的主线程工作，所以工作台本来就只移动 DOM 节点；卷帘订阅同一条总线移动自己的线与滚动容器，「跟随」开关默认开启。
highlights.en: **Playhead and catching**: the roll's playhead moves through a **DOM-only bus** rather than React state (`playheadBus`); re-rendering on every 1/16 step is exactly the main-thread work the earlier responsiveness fixes removed, which is why the studio itself only moves DOM nodes — the roll subscribes to the same bus to move its own line and scroll its container, with catching on by default.

highlights.zh: **证据**：新增 **30 条模型单测**（选择/框选矩形、成组移动与越界拒绝、复制、删除、力度绝对与相对、量化长度、连音封顶与「连音也会缩短」、剪刀成功与拒绝、吸附、音阶解析）与 **18 条组件测试**（工具切换与 `data-tool`、橡皮只删命中的那个、铅笔涂画「首格立即提交 + 整笔一次撤销」、剪刀成功/拒绝并提示、框选选中全部、成组移动、⌥ 复制、力度泳道增删与读数、量化与连音、音阶高亮、力度着色与音名、检视器数值编辑、播放头总线、跟随开关）。**7 端 E2E** 里真的做手势：键盘切工具、拖框选中**全部**音符、拖力度条（实测 100 → 127）、点连音后音符变宽（39.6 → 44.2px）。
highlights.en: **Evidence**: **30 new model tests** (selections and marquee rects, group moves with out-of-range refusal, copy, delete, absolute and relative velocity, quantise lengths, legato's cap and its ability to shorten, scissors succeeding and refusing, snapping, scale parsing) and **18 component tests** (tool switching and `data-tool`, the eraser removing only the note it hit, pencil painting where the first cell commits at once and the stroke is one undo, scissors succeeding/refusing with a notice, a marquee selecting everything, group move, ⌥-copy, the velocity lane's bars and readings, quantise and legato, scale highlighting, velocity colouring and note names, numeric inspector edits, the playhead bus, the catch toggle). The **7-target E2E** performs real gestures: switching tools by keyboard, dragging a marquee that must select **every** note, dragging a velocity bar (measured 100 → 127) and widening a note with legato (39.6 → 44.2 px).

highlights.zh: **诚实说明**：① 步进网格是**单声部且量化**的，所以与 Logic 的差距是结构性的、不是遗漏：音符不能重叠、起点不能落在网格之间、长度是步长的倍数、也没有 Logic 的折叠/智能量化/片段级操作。② 剪刀的「切成两半」是按一半长度切，不是按点击位置精确切（网格上没有可放第二半的中间位置）。③ 力度泳道一次手势作用于命中的条或当前选区，没有 Logic 的「力度工具 + 曲线笔刷」。④ 本机 WebKit 是 Linux WebKitGTK，不等于 macOS Safari。⑤ 慢轨仍按约定交给快机器。
highlights.en: **Honest limitations.** (1) A step grid is **monophonic and quantised**, so the remaining distance to Logic is structural rather than an omission: notes cannot overlap, cannot start between grid positions, their length is a multiple of one step, and there are no fold/scale-aware quantise/region-level operations. (2) The scissors cut at half the note's length rather than exactly where you clicked, because the grid has no intermediate position to hold the second half. (3) The velocity lane acts on the bar you grabbed or on the current selection; there is no Logic-style velocity tool with a curve brush. (4) The WebKit here is WebKitGTK on Linux, not macOS Safari. (5) The slow track still runs on the faster machine by agreement.

title.zh: v2.0.21 效果检查器重做：Logic 式信号链 + 按级编辑，配真实计算的 EQ 频响曲线、压缩器传输曲线与实时增益衰减表、驱动波形曲线
title.en: v2.0.21 The effects inspector is rebuilt: a Logic-style signal chain with per-stage editing, plus a computed EQ response curve, compressor transfer curve and live gain-reduction meter, and the drive's transfer curve

highlights.zh: **从「一长串滑条」变成一条信号链**。原来的效果页把 6 个处理级堆成一列滑条（每个都带开关），既看不出顺序、也看不出各自在做什么；更别扭的是 EQ 挂在「混音」页、压缩与驱动挂在「效果」页，而它们其实是**同一条串联插入链**。现在页首是一条信号链 `HP → EQ → Comp → Drive`（顺序就是 `ChannelStripDsp` 里实际的接线顺序，不是排版顺序），每级有：**电源圆点**（真正改参数的开关）、名称、以及**当前值摘要**（如 `180 Hz`、`-3.0 · +1.0 · +1.0 dB`、`-18 dB · 4.0:1`）。点某一级切换编辑区；被选中的一级展开，其余**保持挂载**（用 `hidden` 切换），所以切换即时、滑条位置与搜索词都不会丢。
highlights.en: **From a long column of sliders to a signal chain.** The old effects page stacked six processors as rows of sliders (each with a switch), which showed neither their order nor what each was doing — and worse, the EQ lived under the *mix* tab while the compressor and drive lived under *effects*, even though all of them are one serial insert chain. The page now opens with the chain `HP → EQ → Comp → Drive` (the order is `ChannelStripDsp`'s actual wiring, not a layout choice), and each stage shows a **power dot** (which really toggles its parameters), its name, and a **live value summary** (`180 Hz`, `-3.0 · +1.0 · +1.0 dB`, `-18 dB · 4.0:1`). Clicking a stage switches the editor; the selected one expands while the others **stay mounted** (toggled with `hidden`), so switching is instant and slider positions and search text survive.

highlights.zh: **三条曲线都是从真实参数算出来的，不是画的图**。新增 `src/audio/insertCurves.ts`，逐项对齐 `ChannelStripDsp` 而不是近似它：滤波器曲线用浏览器 `BiquadFilterNode` 同一套 RBJ 系数公式、同样的 Q（高通用 `INSERT_HPF_Q`、谐振级用该带自己的 Q）；压缩器曲线用 Web Audio 的**软拐点传输函数**，拐点就是那条链路固定的 6 dB（`INSERT_COMP_KNEE_DB`，所以它不是用户参数）；驱动曲线**直接取自整形器自己的查表**（`makeSaturationCurve`，就是填 `WaveShaperNode` 的那个函数），因此画出来的和听到的不可能漂移；**关闭的级不参与**（DSP 是把它从图上摘掉，不是停在中间值）。**18 条单测断言的是传输函数的已知性质**而不是快照数字：巴特沃斯高通在拐点 −3.01 dB、搁架在频谱两端各自到达增益、谐振级在中心频率到达增益、Q 越大越窄、压缩在拐点以下是单位增益、以上严格 1/ratio、跨拐点连续、永不提升、以及各级响应可加。
highlights.en: **All three curves are computed from the live parameters, not drawn pictures.** `src/audio/insertCurves.ts` mirrors `ChannelStripDsp` point for point instead of approximating it: the filter curves use the same RBJ coefficient formulas the browser's `BiquadFilterNode` implements, at the same Q values (`INSERT_HPF_Q` for the high-pass, each band's own Q for the peaking band); the compressor curve is Web Audio's **soft-knee transfer function** with the chain's fixed 6 dB knee (`INSERT_COMP_KNEE_DB`, which is why it is not a user parameter); and the drive curve is sampled from **the shaper's own table** (`makeSaturationCurve`, the very function that fills the `WaveShaperNode`), so the drawing cannot drift from the sound; a **disabled stage contributes nothing**, because the DSP unwires it rather than parking it at a neutral value. **Eighteen unit tests assert known properties of the transfer functions** rather than snapshotting numbers: a Butterworth high-pass is −3.01 dB at its corner; each shelf reaches its gain at its end of the spectrum; a peaking band reaches its gain at its centre and narrows as Q rises; the compressor is unity below the knee, exactly 1/ratio above it, continuous across both knee edges, never boosts, and the stages' responses add.

highlights.zh: **曲线上可以直接拖频点与增益**：EQ 曲线画出四个频段的圆点手柄，拖动即改该带的频率/增益，拖动期间只在本地草稿里重绘、**松手才提交一次**（与钢琴卷帘同一条「一次手势一条撤销」的规矩；每次 pointermove 都提交会把撤销栈冲爆）。**压缩器的增益衰减表读的是正在跑的节点**（`DynamicsCompressorNode.reduction`），不是二次估算；取样放在表组件内部以 ~20 Hz 轮询，因此这个高频更新不会让整个工作台跟着重渲染。
highlights.en: **The curve is editable directly**: the EQ drawing carries a handle per band, and dragging one moves that band's frequency and gain — redrawing from a local draft during the drag and **committing once on release**, the same "one gesture, one undo step" rule the piano roll follows (committing on every pointermove would flood the undo stack). The **compressor's gain-reduction meter reads the running node** (`DynamicsCompressorNode.reduction`) rather than a second estimate, and it is sampled inside the meter component at ~20 Hz so that this fast update does not re-render the studio around it.

highlights.zh: **E2E 真的拖了一次手柄**：新检查断言信号链的四个槽位顺序、按级切换（选中的可见、其余 hidden 但仍挂载）、三条曲线路径存在，然后**在真实浏览器里按下手柄往上拖 24px，要求 mid 增益的输入值随之改变**（实测 `-3 → 5.5`）。它当场抓到两个自身问题：选择器把信号链容器也算成了槽位；以及检查结束后把检查器留在了「效果」页，导致后面的音色搜索框（在「音色」页，已 hidden）`fill` 超时 30 秒——两个都修了，后者顺手记进注释。
highlights.en: **The E2E really drags a handle**: the new check asserts the four slots in chain order, per-stage switching (the selected one visible, the rest hidden but still mounted), and the presence of all three curve paths, then **presses a handle in a real browser and drags it up 24 px, requiring the mid gain input to follow** (measured `-3 → 5.5`). It immediately caught two problems of its own: the selector counted the chain container as a slot; and the check left the inspector on the Effects tab, so a later step's timbre search box (in the Timbre tab, hence hidden) timed out its `fill` after 30 s — both fixed, the second recorded in a comment.

highlights.zh: **诚实说明**：① 这些曲线是**参数所要求的传输函数**，不是对运行中浏览器滤波器的实测响应——浏览器实现同一套公式，但两者不会逐点相同；这一点写在组件注释里，没有暗示它是测量值。② 压缩器的 6 dB 拐点是链路固定值、曲线也按它画；若将来把它做成参数，曲线会自动跟随（它读的是同一个常量）。③ EQ 手柄当前只改频率与增益，**不改 Q**（Q 仍由滑条控制）；也没有画 Q 手柄的交互。④ 本版只做了效果页；**钢琴卷帘的重做（本轮目标的第二项）还没开始**，下一轮继续。⑤ 慢轨仍按约定交给快机器。
highlights.en: **Honest limitations.** (1) These curves are the transfer functions the *parameters ask for*, not a measurement of the running browser filter — the browser implements the same formulas but the two will not agree point for point, and the component comments say so rather than implying a measurement. (2) The compressor's 6 dB knee is fixed by the chain and the curve is drawn with it; if it ever becomes a parameter the curve follows automatically, because it reads the same constant. (3) An EQ handle changes frequency and gain but **not Q** (Q remains a slider), and there is no Q handle. (4) This release covers the effects page only; **the piano roll rebuild — the second half of this objective — has not started** and continues next round. (5) The slow track still runs on the faster machine by agreement.

title.zh: v2.0.20 修播放中切曲风的老/新曲风来回交换与显示闪烁：一次点击触发 5–13 次导航、最多 9 次 pattern 翻转
title.en: v2.0.20 Fixes the old/new genre swapping and flicker when switching genre during playback: one click caused 5–13 navigations and up to 9 pattern flips

highlights.zh: **根因是 effect 依赖了每次渲染都会新建的回调**。`useGenreSwitching` 的外部同步 effect 把 `performSwitch` 与 `requestGenreGuard` 放进了依赖数组，而 `performSwitch` 闭包里的 `onSelectGenre` 是 App 传的**内联箭头**（`onSelectGenre={(g) => handleSelectGenre(g, "studio")}`）——每次 App 重渲染都是一个新函数。于是一次点击变成：切换 → `onSelectGenre` → `navigate` → App 重渲染 → 新回调身份 → **effect 再跑一次** → 再切一次 → …… 浏览器实测（**Chromium 上就能复现，Safari 更严重**），transport 播放中连续三次点击分别产生 **5 / 11 / 13 次 `pushState`** 与最多 **9 次 pattern 签名翻转**，每个来回都重新执行 `SET_GENRE` + `engine.setPattern(..., resetStates=true)` + 重套该曲风的鼓组与 FX 默认值——所以不只是画面闪，声音也不正常。
highlights.en: **The root cause was an effect depending on callbacks that every render reallocates.** `useGenreSwitching`'s external-sync effect listed `performSwitch` and `requestGenreGuard` as dependencies, and `performSwitch` closes over `onSelectGenre` — which `App` passed as an **inline arrow** (`onSelectGenre={(g) => handleSelectGenre(g, "studio")}`), i.e. a new function on every App render. So one click became: switch → `onSelectGenre` → `navigate` → App re-renders → new callback identity → **the effect runs again** → switch again → … Measured in a browser (**reproducible on Chromium, worse on Safari**), three successive clicks with the transport running produced **5 / 11 / 13 `pushState` calls** and up to **9 pattern-signature flips**, each round-trip re-applying `SET_GENRE` + `engine.setPattern(..., resetStates = true)` + the genre's drum kit and FX defaults — which is why the display flickered *and* the sound broke.

highlights.zh: **修法（两层，缺一不可）**：① 同步 effect 改成**边沿触发、且完全不看回调身份**——`performSwitch` 与 guard 通过 ref 读取，依赖只剩下「请求的曲风」与 store 里的当前曲风，并记住「已经因这次请求同步过」，因此同一请求只落一次；② App 侧把 `onSelectGenre`（studio 与 detail 两个去向）改成 `useCallback` 稳定引用，从源头消掉这类抖动。**证据**：修复后同一套测量在 Chromium 与 WebKit 上都是**每次点击 1 次导航、1 次 pattern 翻转**（修复前 5/11/13 与 1/8/9）。
highlights.en: **The fix, in two layers.** (1) The sync effect is now **edge-triggered and blind to callback identity**: `performSwitch` and the guard are read through refs, the dependency list is down to the requested genre and the store's current genre, and the last satisfied request is remembered so one request lands once. (2) `App` now hands over stable `useCallback` references for `onSelectGenre` (both the studio and detail destinations), removing that class of churn at the source. **Evidence:** the same measurement on Chromium and WebKit now shows **1 navigation and 1 pattern flip per click** (it was 5/11/13 navigations and 1/8/9 flips).

highlights.zh: **为什么它能溜过 7 端矩阵**：矩阵从来没有**在播放中切换曲风**——它检查过视图渲染、控制台、控制台面板、设置面板、检查器、卷帘，唯独没碰这条路径。新增的检查用应用自己的活动量作判据（`pushState` 次数 + 步进网格签名翻转次数），并且**先打印后断言**：一旦某次运行被中断，日志里也已经留下了数字。它自己也踩了两个坑，都已在代码注释里写明：**点击落空**（rail 在之前的步骤里已滚出视口，WebKit 上 `force: true` 的坐标点击什么都没发生 → 改用 `clickVerified` 做投递验证），以及**空转通过**（第一次版本是 0 导航 0 翻转却判绿——「没判」被当成「通过」）；现在「点击后什么都没变」直接判失败。
highlights.en: **Why the 7-target matrix let it through:** the matrix never **switched genre while the transport was running** — it covered view rendering, the console, the mixer, the settings panel, the inspector and the roll, but not this path. The new check judges by the app's own activity (count of `pushState` calls + pattern-signature flips) and **prints before it asserts**, so an interrupted run still leaves the numbers in the log. The check itself hit two traps, both now written into the comments: **the click missed** (the rail had been scrolled out of view by earlier steps, and on WebKit a coordinate click with `force: true` did nothing at all — it now goes through `clickVerified`, which proves delivery), and **passing vacuously** (the first version reported 0 navigations and 0 flips and still went green — "not judged" recorded as "passed"). Clicking a chip that changes nothing now fails.

highlights.zh: **另外发现的一个真实交互事实（不是缺陷，但会造成「切换失败」的错觉）**：如果在切换前编辑过 pattern，守卫会先弹「有未保存的修改」对话框，**此时不会切换**——用户会感觉「点了没反应」。矩阵里因为这个对话框，新检查一度连续两次空转。发布说明里写清这条，是为了让「第一次成功、第二三次失败」的两种成因可以区分：**循环**（本次已修，表现为画面来回闪 + 声音乱）与**守卫在问**（画面正常、只是弹窗等你回答）。
highlights.en: **One real interaction fact worth knowing** (not a defect, but it creates the *impression* of a failed switch): if the pattern was edited before switching, the guard asks "unsaved changes" first and **nothing switches until it is answered**, which feels like "the click did nothing". That dialog is what made the new check go vacuous twice in a row. It is documented here so the two causes of "first switch works, later ones fail" can be told apart: the **loop** (fixed in this release; the display swaps back and forth and the sound breaks) versus the **guard asking** (the display is stable and a dialog is waiting).

highlights.zh: **诚实说明**：① 根因与修复都由**浏览器内的活动量测量**确认（导航次数、pattern 翻转次数、双引擎），**没有**用「看起来好了」作为判据；但「耳朵听到的不再乱」仍需你在 Safari 上确认。② 本机的 WebKit 是 Linux 上的 WebKitGTK，**不等于 macOS Safari**；这次能在 WebKit 上复现并修好是加分项，但请在真 Safari 上再走一遍同样的操作。③ 矩阵里这条新检查**依赖应用自己的活动量**：如果将来路由不再使用 `pushState`，导航计数会变成 0 而检查会（正确地）判失败，需要同步更新判据。④ 这次没有重跑慢轨（本机慢轨交给快机器的约定不变）：本版只有 3 个源码文件 + 1 个 E2E 检查的改动，fast 轨、7 端 E2E、redlines/docs/version/budget 与四个证据门禁都已通过。
highlights.en: **Honest limitations.** (1) Both the root cause and the fix were established by **measuring activity inside the browser** (navigation count, pattern-flip count, two engines) rather than by judging that it "looks better" — but whether it *sounds* right still needs your confirmation on Safari. (2) The WebKit here is WebKitGTK on Linux, **not macOS Safari**; reproducing and fixing it on WebKit is a bonus, but please repeat the same actions in real Safari. (3) The new matrix check **depends on the app's own activity**: if routing ever stops using `pushState`, the navigation count becomes 0 and the check will (correctly) fail, so the criterion needs updating with it. (4) The slow track was not re-run here — the agreement to run it on the faster machine stands. This release changes three source files plus one E2E check, and the fast track, the 7-target matrix, redlines/docs/version/budget and the four evidence gates are all green.

title.zh: v2.0.19 三项使用反馈：钢琴卷帘默认满宽（并可全屏/收起/关闭）、GS-1 与换音色的卡顿根因、轨道检查器改成分类 tab
title.en: v2.0.19 Three pieces of feedback from real use: the piano roll fills the width by default (and can go fullscreen, collapse or close), the root causes behind the GS-1 and timbre-switch stalls, and a tabbed track inspector

highlights.zh: **钢琴卷帘只有屏幕 1/3 宽——因为格子宽度是写死的像素**。第一版用 `ZOOMS = [14, 20, 26, …]` 直接当格子宽度，于是音符网格永远是 `步数 × 26px`：16 步就是 416px，在 1440px 的屏幕上正好约 1/3，抽屉剩下的地方全空着。现在缩放是**相对容器宽度的倍数**（用 `ResizeObserver` 量抽屉宽度再算格子宽），默认 1× 就是**铺满**，缩放按钮从 0.5× 到 2× 在此基础上放大缩小；格子宽有 10px 下限（32 步在窄屏上不会被压成看不见）。新增两个状态：**全屏**（`fixed inset-0`，带安全区内边距，Esc 先退全屏再关面板，因为那是更小的一步）与**收起**（只留工具栏——轨选择、缩放、移调、关闭都还在，编辑区卸载）。E2E 量的是几何：网格宽度必须 ≥ 抽屉宽度 − 60px、全屏盒子必须覆盖视口、收起后编辑区必须消失而工具栏必须还在。
highlights.en: **The piano roll was about a third of the screen because its cell width was a hard-coded pixel size.** The first version used `ZOOMS = [14, 20, 26, …]` as the cell width directly, so the note grid was always `steps × 26px` — 416 px for a 16-step pattern, almost exactly a third of a 1440 px screen, with the rest of the drawer empty. Zoom is now a **factor on a cell width derived from the measured container** (a `ResizeObserver` watches the drawer), so the default 1× **fills** it and the zoom buttons scale from 0.5× to 2×; the cell width has a 10 px floor so a 32-step pattern on a phone does not collapse into nothing. Two new states came with it: **fullscreen** (`fixed inset-0` with safe-area padding; Escape leaves fullscreen first, because that is the smaller step) and **collapsed** (toolbar only — track selector, zoom, transpose and close all remain — with the editor unmounted). The E2E checks the geometry: the grid must be at least the drawer width minus 60 px, the fullscreen box must cover the viewport, and collapsing must remove the editor while keeping the toolbar.

highlights.zh: **GS-1 开关与播放中换音色的卡顿，根因有三个，都在主线程的生命周期上**。① **每次换音色都在重建 host**：`ensureTrack`/`tryPlay` 把「乐器名不同」当成「拆掉这个 slot、重新加载一个 host」，于是从一个 GS-1 patch 换到另一个，会先销毁一个完全可用的 worklet、让接下来几个音**回退到原生引擎**、等新 host 编译完再切回来——听感就是「换音色没反应，过一会儿才变」。host 与乐器无关（patch 只是一组参数），现在**就地把新 patch 推给同一个 host**；新乐器若没有 GS-1 patch（例如钢琴这类刻意保留原生的），也只是**不用**它发声，host 仍然留着，切回来是即时的。② **关闭 GS-1 时同步销毁**：`releaseAll()` + `dispose()` 原本都写在点击处理里，正在播放时等于在主线程上拆掉每个 worklet 节点并释放 WASM——这就是「一切就像卡住」。现在**先静音、后释放**：`releaseAll()` 立即执行（声音立刻停），销毁延后 3 秒；在这 3 秒内切回来则**取消销毁**，已加载的 host 留着，等于白得一次瞬时开关。③ **每次 pattern 提交都重推 8 条插入链**：`setPattern` 在**每一次**提交时都会跑（切一步、换音色、拖完一次力度），而它逐轨调 `setTrackInsert`。现在只重推**真正变了**的轨，并把 `resolveTrackInsertForGenre` 的结果按「曲风|角色」记忆化（它每次都新建对象，而这里正是靠对象标识判断「没变」）；诊断计数 `getPatternInsertApplications()` 让省下来的工作量可被测试断言（改一条轨的链条 = 1 次而不是 8 次）。
highlights.en: **The stalls around the GS-1 switch and around switching timbre during playback have three root causes, all of them main-thread lifecycle work.** (1) **Every timbre change rebuilt the host**: `ensureTrack`/`tryPlay` treated "a different instrument" as "tear this slot down and load another host", so switching from one GS-1 patch to another disposed a perfectly usable worklet, played the next notes on the **native** engine while the replacement compiled, and only then switched back — heard as "the timbre did not change, then it did". A host is instrument-agnostic (a patch is just parameters), so the new patch is now pushed **into the same host**; if the new instrument has no GS-1 patch at all (a piano, deliberately left native), the host is simply not used for it and **stays alive**, which makes switching back immediate. (2) **Switching GS-1 off disposed synchronously**, inside the click handler: tearing down every worklet node and freeing its WASM on the main thread while the transport runs is precisely the "it feels stuck" report. It is now **silence first, release later**: `releaseAll()` runs immediately (the sound stops at once) and the disposal is deferred by three seconds; rejoining inside that window **cancels** it and keeps the loaded hosts, so a quick off/on is free. (3) **Every pattern commit re-pushed all eight insert chains.** `setPattern` runs on *every* commit (a step, a timbre, a coalesced drag) and it called `setTrackInsert` per track. It now re-applies only the tracks that actually changed, and memoises `resolveTrackInsertForGenre` per (genre, role) — that resolver allocates, and object identity is exactly how "unchanged" is decided here. The diagnostic counter `getPatternInsertApplications()` makes the saving assertable in tests (editing one track's chain is 1 application, not 8).

highlights.zh: **一个可复用的测量脚本，因为「卡」不能靠读代码断言**：`scripts/measure_interaction_latency.mjs` 在真实浏览器里量每个交互的 **点击→DOM 真的反映变化** 的延迟，以及期间主线程的 **long task**（>50ms 的阻塞；那正是「卡住」的感觉，也是会饿死调度器前瞻的东西）。第一次写它时我把固定 `setTimeout` 当成 settle，于是把一个几毫秒的状态翻转量成了 8 秒——现在的 inspect 等的是**可观测状态**（`aria-pressed` 翻转、选项 `aria-selected` 变 true、格子 `aria-selected` 改变）。本机（无头 Chromium，桌面视口，同一脚本同一条件）修复前后：**GS-1 关 119.5 → 38.8 ms、开 71.5 → 23.9 ms**（约 3 倍）；**换音色 81/160/215/108 → 89/81/63/59 ms**（最差那个从 215 ms 降到 63 ms）；切一步 59.6 → 45.1 ms；long task 前后都是 0。**诚实说明：在开发机上没有复现出用户描述的那种卡顿**（0 个 long task），所以这次修的是**会产生该卡顿的机制**，而不是「我看到了同一个现象」；脚本已入库，可以在真正出问题的那台机器上直接跑。
highlights.en: **A reusable probe, because "it stutters" cannot be asserted by reading code.** `scripts/measure_interaction_latency.mjs` measures, in a real browser, each interaction's **click → the DOM actually reflecting it** latency plus the main thread's **long tasks** during it (>50 ms of blocking is what "stuck" feels like, and it is what starves the scheduler's lookahead). The first version of the probe used a fixed `setTimeout` as its settle, which is how it reported eight seconds for a toggle that settles in milliseconds; it now waits for the **observable** state (`aria-pressed` flipping, an option's `aria-selected` becoming true, a cell's `aria-selected` changing). On this machine (headless Chromium, desktop viewport, same probe and conditions), before → after: **GS-1 off 119.5 → 38.8 ms and on 71.5 → 23.9 ms** (about 3x faster); **timbre switches 81/160/215/108 → 89/81/63/59 ms** (the worst case drops from 215 ms to 63 ms); toggling a step 59.6 → 45.1 ms; long tasks were zero in both runs. **Stated honestly: the stall the user described was not reproduced on the development machine** (no long tasks at all), so what this release fixes are the *mechanisms that would produce it* rather than an observed reproduction — and the probe ships so it can be run where it happens.

highlights.zh: **轨道检查器改成三个 tab**（音色 / 混音 / 效果），并按「切换要即时、状态不能丢」来做：三个分组**始终挂载**，用 `hidden` 属性切换可见性——所以切 tab 不会重新挂载（滑条位置、音色搜索框里的关键词、正在拖动的状态都还在），切换是瞬时的。**M/S 移到了头部**：静音和独奏是随时要按的东西，不该藏在某个 tab 后面（E2E 断言它们不在任何 `[hidden]` 祖先里）。分组标题复用了已有的 `track_inspector_section_*` 文案，没有新增重复的 i18n。
highlights.en: **The track inspector is now three tabs** (Timbre / Mix / Effects), built so that switching is instant and nothing is thrown away: all three groups stay **mounted** and are toggled with the `hidden` attribute, so changing tabs does not remount them — a slider keeps its position, the timbre search keeps its query, a drag in progress survives. **Mute and solo moved into the header**: those are pressed constantly and must not be behind a tab (the E2E asserts neither has a `[hidden]` ancestor). The tab labels reuse the existing `track_inspector_section_*` strings rather than adding parallel i18n.
